title: Business Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.


1, Document Preparation and Analysis (Pre-Shipment): This phase focuses on ensuring all documentation is correct before shipment. It includes receiving and checking the Purchase Order (PO), the fiscal classification (NCM) of the goods, analyzing draft documents (CI, PL, BL drafts), and initial registration in the system.



2, Shipment Management and Customs Procedures: This stage covers the active management of the process while the cargo is in transit. It involves obtaining the Import License (LI), collecting original documents, validating the Bill of Lading (BL), and continuous coordination with the customs broker and the bonded terminal


.
3, Clearance Monitoring and Closing (Post-Arrival): This phase begins upon cargo arrival. It includes full door-to-door logistics follow-up, cargo presence confirmation, monitoring customs clearance (DI/DUIMP), coordinating domestic transport, and finally, archiving all documents to close the proces


s.
4, Invoice Auditing and Cost Validation: This phase focuses on verifying the accuracy of all operational costs before payment. It includes receiving and cross-referencing invoices (from freight forwarders, carriers, terminals, customs brokers) against negotiated tariffs, operational records, and system data (e.g., demurrage/detention days, storage fees) to identify and dispute discrepanci


es.
5, Payment Processing and Budget Allocation: This stage covers the financial execution and control. It involves launching approved invoices into the financial system (ERP), correctly allocating all costs to the specific import process or cost center, scheduling payments according to financial policy, and serving as the main point of contact for supplier payment inquir


ies.
6, Cost Analysis and Performance Reporting: This final phase focuses on data analysis and strategic support. It includes compiling financial data, generating periodic reports (e.g., total logistics cost, cost-per-container, variance analysis against budget), and providing data-driven insights to support new supplier negotiations and identify cost-saving opportuni

ties.

description:

title: Business Intelligence Analyst - Remote Work
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Intelligence Analyst - Remote Work em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Business Intelligence Analyst to join our team. This professional will be responsible for taking raw information – numbers or qualitative data sets – and constructing narratives that help our business colleagues to make better decisions. Benefits:

title: Information technology manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Information technology manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company's foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration.

Key Responsibilities

Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation)

Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes. Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes. Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations. Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools.

Automation, Integration & AI Implementation

Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our Saa S ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, Java Script). Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks. Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.

IT Administration & Security

Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365). Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access. Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security. Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate Saa S contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.

Required Qualifications & Skills

Technical Experience:

5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration. Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment. Strong understanding of cloud-based Saa S ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures. High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting. Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows. Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.

Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:

Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity. Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms. Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.

Benefits & Compensation

Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

title: Senior machine learning engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior machine learning engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next‐generation AI‐native B2 B platform for hospitality. We're looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who is excited about the craft of machine learning—especially the mathematical and statistical foundations behind models—and who can turn that depth into solutions that scale in real-world use. If you're someone who enjoys choosing the right model for the problem, validating it rigorously, and improving it through iteration, you'll feel at home here.

This is an opportunity for an engineer who wants to grow into a future architect, help define large-scale backend systems, and become a true technical champion within the team. If you are passionate about modern backend engineering, clean architecture, and scalable distributed systems, you'll love working with us.

What you'll do

Design, train, and improve statistical and machine learning models for real product use cases. Apply strong fundamentals in probability, statistics, and modeling to make sound decisions on approach and evaluation. Build scalable ML solutions that can be used reliably in production environments. Develop capabilities to support agent-like experiences within our platform (e.g., intelligent workflows, tool-using behaviors, retrieval patterns, guardrails). Define and monitor meaningful model metrics, run error analysis, and iterate based on results.

What we're looking for

We're intentionally not treating this as a checklist. If you're strong in the fundamentals and have built real ML systems, we'd love to hear from you.

You'll be successful in this role if you have:

Strong knowledge across a broad range of machine learning algorithms (supervised/unsupervised methods, ensembles, linear models, tree-based methods, deep learning basics) and the judgment to choose appropriately. Solid grounding in statistics and mathematical reasoning (e.g., bias/variance tradeoffs, uncertainty, evaluation design). Experience building ML solutions in practice: data understanding, feature design, training, evaluation, and iteration. Strong Python skills and the ability to write clear, maintainable code. Familiarity with standard ML tooling (e.g., scikit-learn, Py Torch/Tensor Flow).

Nice to have (not required)

Experience with NLP and/or LLMs (helpful, but not a core requirement). Exposure to ML-related capabilities on AWS, such as training/inference workflows or managed ML services (e.g., Sage Maker), and working with storage/data access patterns commonly used for ML. Experience implementing or integrating vector search / embedding-based retrieval.

Why Join Us

You will work in a modern, AI-native engineering culture building applied machine learning systems that ship. You'll have the opportunity to design mathematically grounded models, turn them into scalable product capabilities, and help define how intelligent agents live inside our platform. This role is ideal for someone who loves ML fundamentals, enjoys solving real problems end-to-end, and wants to grow into a senior technical leader shaping our ML direction.

Equal Opportunity

Directful is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of any protected characteristic.

title: Customer success manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer success manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Employment Type: Full-time position employed by a partner agency (3rd party, B2 B)

About Sisense

Sisense is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (An Paa S) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology.

With the recent launch of Sisense Intelligence and the Intelligence Assistant, we are accelerating innovation in embedded analytics, enabling governed, scalable AI experiences that bridge insights to real-time action.

The Role

As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted advisor to mid-sized to large enterprise accounts. You will build deep relationships, drive adoption of our AI-powered platform, maximize value, and fuel retention and expansion. You will collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers achieve their business goals through clear communication and proactive guidance.

Why Join Our Customer Success Team

This is a strategic, high-impact role where you will own complex accounts, strengthen multi-threaded relationships, and deliver measurable outcomes (NRR, expansion revenue, AI feature adoption). You will work in a collaborative, innovative global environment, partnering with diverse teams to solve real customer challenges and contribute to Sisense's growth in embedded AI analytics.

About You

You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly while staying positive and solution-focused. You are a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor. You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs. You are proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities. You are collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning.

Requirements

3–5 years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent), with proven success managing enterprise/mid-market accounts (Saa S/BI/analytics preferred). Strong track record driving product adoption, value realization, NRR, and revenue expansion. Excellent presentation and executive communication skills; experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships. Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio. Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI. Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions. Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps. Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required; Portuguese a plus). Results-driven with critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus. Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment managing multiple priorities. Bonus: Background in Business Intelligence (BI), embedded analytics, AI/Gen AI enablement, or similar technical solutions.

How You'll Ramp

By Day 30

Complete Customer Success onboarding and training (Sisense values, culture, relationship techniques, product overview, competition, and transformational outcomes). Begin meeting customers, shadowing QBRs/EBRs, and observing how we build relationships and deliver value.

By Day 60

Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals). Deepen product/technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work. Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side-by-side with the team.

By Day 90

Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion). Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement. Become a key contributor to the team's revenue retention and growth goals.

What We Offer

Employment through a partner agency (B2 B). Competitive base salary up to USD 3,500 per month (depending on experience). Eligibility for a quarterly performance bonus. Opportunity to work with a global leader in AI-powered embedded analytics. Flexible remote work with a collaborative international team. Professional development and growth opportunities within Customer Success.

title: Business specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

1, Document Preparation and Analysis (Pre-Shipment): This phase focuses on ensuring all documentation is correct before shipment. It includes receiving and checking the Purchase Order (PO), the fiscal classification (NCM) of the goods, analyzing draft documents (CI, PL, BL drafts), and initial registration in the system.


2, Shipment Management and Customs Procedures: This stage covers the active management of the process while the cargo is in transit. It involves obtaining the Import License (LI), collecting original documents, validating the Bill of Lading (BL), and continuous coordination with the customs broker and the bonded terminal

.
3, Clearance Monitoring and Closing (Post-Arrival): This phase begins upon cargo arrival. It includes full door-to-door logistics follow-up, cargo presence confirmation, monitoring customs clearance (DI/DUIMP), coordinating domestic transport, and finally, archiving all documents to close the proces

s.
4, Invoice Auditing and Cost Validation: This phase focuses on verifying the accuracy of all operational costs before payment. It includes receiving and cross-referencing invoices (from freight forwarders, carriers, terminals, customs brokers) against negotiated tariffs, operational records, and system data (e.g., demurrage/detention days, storage fees) to identify and dispute discrepanci

es.
5, Payment Processing and Budget Allocation: This stage covers the financial execution and control. It involves launching approved invoices into the financial system (ERP), correctly allocating all costs to the specific import process or cost center, scheduling payments according to financial policy, and serving as the main point of contact for supplier payment inquir

ies.
6, Cost Analysis and Performance Reporting: This final phase focuses on data analysis and strategic support. It includes compiling financial data, generating periodic reports (e.g., total logistics cost, cost-per-container, variance analysis against budget), and providing data-driven insights to support new supplier negotiations and identify cost-saving opportuni ties.

title: Business specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

1, Document Preparation and Analysis (Pre-Shipment): This phase focuses on ensuring all documentation is correct before shipment. It includes receiving and checking the Purchase Order (PO), the fiscal classification (NCM) of the goods, analyzing draft documents (CI, PL, BL drafts), and initial registration in the system.

2, Shipment Management and Customs Procedures: This stage covers the active management of the process while the cargo is in transit. It involves obtaining the Import License (LI), collecting original documents, validating the Bill of Lading (BL), and continuous coordination with the customs broker and the bonded terminal

.
3, Clearance Monitoring and Closing (Post-Arrival): This phase begins upon cargo arrival. It includes full door-to-door logistics follow-up, cargo presence confirmation, monitoring customs clearance (DI/DUIMP), coordinating domestic transport, and finally, archiving all documents to close the proces

s.
4, Invoice Auditing and Cost Validation: This phase focuses on verifying the accuracy of all operational costs before payment. It includes receiving and cross-referencing invoices (from freight forwarders, carriers, terminals, customs brokers) against negotiated tariffs, operational records, and system data (e.g., demurrage/detention days, storage fees) to identify and dispute discrepanci

es.
5, Payment Processing and Budget Allocation: This stage covers the financial execution and control. It involves launching approved invoices into the financial system (ERP), correctly allocating all costs to the specific import process or cost center, scheduling payments according to financial policy, and serving as the main point of contact for supplier payment inquir

ies.
6, Cost Analysis and Performance Reporting: This final phase focuses on data analysis and strategic support. It includes compiling financial data, generating periodic reports (e.g., total logistics cost, cost-per-container, variance analysis against budget), and providing data-driven insights to support new supplier negotiations and identify cost-saving opportuni ties.

Product Owner – Client Onboarding & Customer Success

Remote (Brazil-based) | Supporting UK & US stakeholders | 8,000 - 10,000 BRL

We're proud to be partnering with an innovative, fast-growing Saa S business that is transforming how organisations deliver professional online auction experiences under their own brand. Following a period of impressive growth, our client is now looking to appoint a Product Owner – Client Onboarding & Customer Success to play a pivotal role in their next phase.

The Opportunity

As Product Owner, you'll take the lead in ensuring new clients are seamlessly onboarded and set up for success from day one. Working closely with senior leadership, engineering, and customer success, you'll help clients quickly reach their first live auction and build long-term confidence using the platform.

Experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or Saa S Implementation specialist A strong track record in customer success, onboarding, or client-facing roles Ability to translate client needs into structured product requirements Comfortable working cross-functionally with technical and non-technical teams Highly organised, proactive, and confident managing multiple stakeholders Exposure to B2 B Saa S, Agile environments, or platform-based products would be highly advantageous.

Why Apply?

Join a scaling, globally-focused Saa S business at an exciting stage of growth Work directly with an experienced and passionate leadership team Have real influence over product direction and client success Fully remote role with international collaboration Be instrumental in shaping how clients experience and succeed with the platform

If you're a product-minded professional who thrives on solving real client problems and driving meaningful outcomes, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Senior machine learning engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior machine learning engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next‐generation AI‐native B2 B platform for hospitality. We're looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who is excited about the craft of machine learning—especially the mathematical and statistical foundations behind models—and who can turn that depth into solutions that scale in real-world use. If you're someone who enjoys choosing the right model for the problem, validating it rigorously, and improving it through iteration, you'll feel at home here.

This is an opportunity for an engineer who wants to grow into a future architect, help define large-scale backend systems, and become a true technical champion within the team. If you are passionate about modern backend engineering, clean architecture, and scalable distributed systems, you'll love working with us.

What you'll do

Design, train, and improve statistical and machine learning models for real product use cases. Apply strong fundamentals in probability, statistics, and modeling to make sound decisions on approach and evaluation. Build scalable ML solutions that can be used reliably in production environments. Develop capabilities to support agent-like experiences within our platform (e.g., intelligent workflows, tool-using behaviors, retrieval patterns, guardrails). Define and monitor meaningful model metrics, run error analysis, and iterate based on results.

What we're looking for

We're intentionally not treating this as a checklist. If you're strong in the fundamentals and have built real ML systems, we'd love to hear from you.

You'll be successful in this role if you have:

Strong knowledge across a broad range of machine learning algorithms (supervised/unsupervised methods, ensembles, linear models, tree-based methods, deep learning basics) and the judgment to choose appropriately. Solid grounding in statistics and mathematical reasoning (e.g., bias/variance tradeoffs, uncertainty, evaluation design). Experience building ML solutions in practice: data understanding, feature design, training, evaluation, and iteration. Strong Python skills and the ability to write clear, maintainable code. Familiarity with standard ML tooling (e.g., scikit-learn, Py Torch/Tensor Flow).

Nice to have (not required)

Experience with NLP and/or LLMs (helpful, but not a core requirement). Exposure to ML-related capabilities on AWS, such as training/inference workflows or managed ML services (e.g., Sage Maker), and working with storage/data access patterns commonly used for ML. Experience implementing or integrating vector search / embedding-based retrieval.

Why Join Us

You will work in a modern, AI-native engineering culture building applied machine learning systems that ship. You'll have the opportunity to design mathematically grounded models, turn them into scalable product capabilities, and help define how intelligent agents live inside our platform. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and You Tube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigour. You will actively design prompts from your personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalised responses, evaluating dimensions such as grounding, integration, and helpfulness.

Offer Details:

Duration of Contract: 12 months Pay: $1500 per month (net/take-home) Mode of work: Fully Remote Number of Positions: 20 Must have fluency in Portugal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese)

Key Qualifications:

Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portugal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese) with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project. Personal Account Usage: Willing to use computer science, primary personal Google account (not a testing account), and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment. Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team. Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate the ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalisation quality. Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities. Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalisation concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalisation, poor inferences, and forced connections. Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (Sx S) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and over-narrating. Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers. Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Technical Setup: Desktop/laptop set up with a good internet connection.

Description:

In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalised AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve: Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilise your personal information and experiences. Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalisation was appropriately applied. Analysing responses for grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations. Assessing integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"over-narrating\". Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (Sx S) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable. Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation. Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.

2, Shipment Management and Customs Procedures: This stage covers the active management of the process while the cargo is in transit. .

s.
4, Invoice Auditing and Cost Validation: This phase focuses on verifying the accuracy of all operational costs before payment. It includes receiving and cross-referencing invoices (from freight forwarders, carriers, terminals, customs brokers) against negotiated tariffs, operational records, and system data (e.g., demurrage/detention days, storage fees) to identify and dispute discrepanci

es.
5, Payment Processing and Budget Allocation: This stage covers the financial execution and control. It involves launching approved invoices into the financial system (ERP), correctly allocating all costs to the specific import process or cost center, scheduling payments according to financial policy, and serving as the main point of contact for supplier payment inquir

ies.
6, Cost Analysis and Performance Reporting: This final phase focuses on data analysis and strategic support. It includes compiling financial data, generating periodic reports (e.g., total logistics cost, cost-per-container, variance analysis against budget), and providing data-driven insights to support new supplier negotiations and identify cost-saving opportuni ties.

title: English teacher
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para English teacher em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.

If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.

What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!

In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:

Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.

Minimum Requirements:

Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

Who we are:

Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Customer success manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer success manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Employment Type: Full-time position employed by a partner agency (3rd party, B2 B)

About Sisense

Sisense is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (An Paa S) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology.

With the recent launch of Sisense Intelligence and the Intelligence Assistant, we are accelerating innovation in embedded analytics, enabling governed, scalable AI experiences that bridge insights to real-time action.

The Role

As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted advisor to mid-sized to large enterprise accounts. You will build deep relationships, drive adoption of our AI-powered platform, maximize value, and fuel retention and expansion. You will collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers achieve their business goals through clear communication and proactive guidance.

Why Join Our Customer Success Team

This is a strategic, high-impact role where you will own complex accounts, strengthen multi-threaded relationships, and deliver measurable outcomes (NRR, expansion revenue, AI feature adoption). You will work in a collaborative, innovative global environment, partnering with diverse teams to solve real customer challenges and contribute to Sisense's growth in embedded AI analytics.

About You

You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly while staying positive and solution-focused. You are a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor. You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs. You are proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities. You are collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning.

Requirements

3–5 years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent), with proven success managing enterprise/mid-market accounts (Saa S/BI/analytics preferred). Strong track record driving product adoption, value realization, NRR, and revenue expansion. Excellent presentation and executive communication skills; experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships. Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio. Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI. Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions. Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps. Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required; Portuguese a plus). Results-driven with critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus. Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment managing multiple priorities. Bonus: Background in Business Intelligence (BI), embedded analytics, AI/Gen AI enablement, or similar technical solutions.

How You'll Ramp

By Day 30

Complete Customer Success onboarding and training (Sisense values, culture, relationship techniques, product overview, competition, and transformational outcomes). Begin meeting customers, shadowing QBRs/EBRs, and observing how we build relationships and deliver value.

By Day 60

Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals). Deepen product/technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work. Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side-by-side with the team.

By Day 90

Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion). Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement. Become a key contributor to the team's revenue retention and growth goals.

What We Offer

Employment through a partner agency (B2 B). Competitive base salary up to USD 3,500 per month (depending on experience). Eligibility for a quarterly performance bonus. Opportunity to work with a global leader in AI-powered embedded analytics. Flexible remote work with a collaborative international team. Professional development and growth opportunities within Customer Success.

title: Senior machine learning engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior machine learning engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next‐generation AI‐native B2 B platform for hospitality. We're looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who is excited about the craft of machine learning—especially the mathematical and statistical foundations behind models—and who can turn that depth into solutions that scale in real-world use. If you're someone who enjoys choosing the right model for the problem, validating it rigorously, and improving it through iteration, you'll feel at home here.

This is an opportunity for an engineer who wants to grow into a future architect, help define large-scale backend systems, and become a true technical champion within the team. If you are passionate about modern backend engineering, clean architecture, and scalable distributed systems, you'll love working with us.

What you'll do

Design, train, and improve statistical and machine learning models for real product use cases. Apply strong fundamentals in probability, statistics, and modeling to make sound decisions on approach and evaluation. Build scalable ML solutions that can be used reliably in production environments. Develop capabilities to support agent-like experiences within our platform (e.g., intelligent workflows, tool-using behaviors, retrieval patterns, guardrails). Define and monitor meaningful model metrics, run error analysis, and iterate based on results.

What we're looking for

We're intentionally not treating this as a checklist. If you're strong in the fundamentals and have built real ML systems, we'd love to hear from you.

You'll be successful in this role if you have:

Strong knowledge across a broad range of machine learning algorithms (supervised/unsupervised methods, ensembles, linear models, tree-based methods, deep learning basics) and the judgment to choose appropriately. Solid grounding in statistics and mathematical reasoning (e.g., bias/variance tradeoffs, uncertainty, evaluation design). Experience building ML solutions in practice: data understanding, feature design, training, evaluation, and iteration. Strong Python skills and the ability to write clear, maintainable code. Familiarity with standard ML tooling (e.g., scikit-learn, Py Torch/Tensor Flow).

Nice to have (not required)

Experience with NLP and/or LLMs (helpful, but not a core requirement). Exposure to ML-related capabilities on AWS, such as training/inference workflows or managed ML services (e.g., Sage Maker), and working with storage/data access patterns commonly used for ML. Experience implementing or integrating vector search / embedding-based retrieval.

Why Join Us

You will work in a modern, AI-native engineering culture building applied machine learning systems that ship. You'll have the opportunity to design mathematically grounded models, turn them into scalable product capabilities, and help define how intelligent agents live inside our platform. This role is ideal for someone who loves ML fundamentals, enjoys solving real problems end-to-end, and wants to grow into a senior technical leader shaping our ML direction.

Equal Opportunity

Directful is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of any protected characteristic.

title: Motion designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Motion designer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

LEIA A DESCRIÇÃO!

Para se candidatar, preencha o formulário: Wr B1wdp28 NOSSO JEITO DE SER E FAZER

O time da Pay Conductor é feito por pessoas obcecadas por resolver problemas reais de pagamentos: gente que entende que cada décimo de ponto na taxa de aprovação representa milhões na ponta dos nossos clientes.

Acreditamos que orquestração não é só tecnologia, é devolver às empresas o controle sobre o seu próprio dinheiro. Construímos uma plataforma AI-driven que conecta adquirentes, gateways e meios de pagamento em uma única camada inteligente, e estamos só começando.

Se você quer fazer parte do time que está redefinindo a infraestrutura de pagamentos do Brasil, é aqui.

E aí, quer construir o futuro dos pagamentos com a gente? SOBRE A VAGA

O time de Marketing da Pay Conductor é responsável por traduzir uma plataforma técnica e robusta em uma marca desejada por empreendedores digitais, varejistas, e-commerces e líderes do mercado financeiro.

A sua missão como Motion Designer será transformar conceitos complexos, como roteamento inteligente, taxa de aprovação, antifraude, recuperação de vendas e inteligência de pagamentos, em vídeos, animações e peças visuais que prendem atenção, explicam com clareza e fortalecem a percepção da marca.

Buscamos uma pessoa criativa, detalhista e com repertório visual forte. Alguém que entenda que motion não é apenas "fazer elementos se mexerem", mas construir narrativa, ritmo e impacto visual.

Você vai trabalhar de perto com Marketing, Conteúdo, Design e fundadores, criando assets para redes sociais, campanhas, materiais comerciais, eventos, lançamentos e apresentações. Mais do que executar briefings, queremos alguém que proponha caminhos visuais, teste formatos e ajude a construir uma marca forte, moderna e memorável. VOCÊ TERÁ ENTRE SUAS RESPONSABILIDADES:

Criar vídeos e animações para os canais oficiais da Pay Conductor, como Linked In, Instagram, You Tube, site e novos canais conforme estratégia. Desenvolver motion graphics para posts, carrosséis animados, reels, vídeos curtos, campanhas e materiais institucionais. Transformar roteiros e conceitos técnicos em animações claras, bonitas e fáceis de entender. Animar ícones, gráficos, interfaces, fluxos de pagamento, dashboards, transações e elementos visuais da marca. Apoiar a produção de vídeos para campanhas de mídia paga, eventos, lançamentos e ações comerciais. Criar variações de peças animadas para testes de performance e diferentes formatos de distribuição. Editar vídeos curtos com ritmo, cortes, legendas, trilhas, transições e acabamento profissional. Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com Design e Conteúdo para garantir coesão visual e narrativa da marca. Ajudar a evoluir a linguagem visual da Pay Conductor em movimento, respeitando identidade, paleta, tipografia e estilo da marca. Trazer referências visuais, tendências de motion, formatos de redes sociais e ideias para elevar a qualidade criativa dos conteúdos. VOCÊ AGREGARÁ SE POSSUIR: Portfólio com projetos de motion design, edição de vídeo, animação ou peças em movimento. Domínio de ferramentas como After Effects, Premiere, Illustrator, Photoshop, Figma, Cap Cut ou similares. Boa noção de composição visual, ritmo, hierarquia, transição, storytelling e acabamento. Sensibilidade estética para criar peças modernas, limpas e com aparência premium. Capacidade de transformar temas técnicos em narrativas visuais simples e interessantes. Organização para lidar com múltiplas demandas em uma rotina dinâmica de marketing. Repertório ativo de referências visuais, redes sociais, design, tecnologia e cultura digital. Vontade de aprender sobre fintech, pagamentos, e-commerce e inteligência artificial. VOCÊ SE DESTACARÁ SE TIVER: Experiência prévia com marcas B2 B, Saa S, fintech, tecnologia, meios de pagamento ou e-commerce. Experiência com animação de UI, dashboards, fluxos de produto e interfaces digitais. Conhecimento em Lottie, Rive, Cinema 4 D, Blender ou outras ferramentas de animação/3 D. Experiência criando vídeos para campanhas de performance, anúncios e testes de criativos. Noções de design gráfico, direção de arte e criação de conceitos visuais. Familiaridade com ferramentas de IA aplicadas à criação, edição, storyboard ou geração de assets. Repertório de marcas com identidade visual forte, linguagem tecnológica e comunicação diferenciada. O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

Esperamos uma pessoa com olhar apurado, autonomia criativa e vontade real de construir.

Alguém que consiga pegar um tema complexo e transformar em uma animação clara. Que saiba equilibrar estética com comunicação. Que entenda quando uma peça precisa ser mais institucional, mais comercial, mais educativa ou mais social-first.

Na Pay Conductor, você terá espaço para propor, testar e evoluir a linguagem visual de uma marca que está entrando em uma categoria nova e estratégica para o mercado brasileiro.

Para se candidatar, preencha o formulário: Wr B1wdp28

title: Regional study director, latam
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Regional study director, latam em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Crinetics is a pharmaceutical company headquartered in San Diego, California, with a growing presence in Latin America, including an office in Brazil. We are developing much-needed therapies for people with endocrine diseases and endocrine-related tumors. We were founded by a dedicated team of scientists with the simple belief that better therapies developed from rigorous innovation can lead to better lives. Our work continues to make a real difference in the lives of patients. We have a prolific discovery engine and a robust preclinical and clinical development pipeline. We are driven by science with a patient-centric and team-oriented culture. Crinetics is known for its inclusive workplace culture. This is an exciting time to join Crinetics as we expand our operations in Latin America and shape our organization into the world's premier fully integrated endocrine company from discovery to patients. Join our team as we transform the lives of others.

Position Summary:

Please note, the candidate for this role will need to be located in Brazil.

The Regional Study Director, LATAM is responsible for managing the execution of clinical studies and data collection within the LATAM region. The incumbent will serve as a regional clinical study lead who oversees the review, monitoring, and adherence to clinical protocols, as well as managing and building relationships with clinical sites in LATAM. The Regional Study Director, LATAM may oversee other regional study leads within the region to facilitate a streamlined and quality study execution. This role will also work internally and externally with members of the cross-functional study team.

Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities:

These may include but are not limited to:

Provide oversight of clinical research studies for LATAM. Manage and build relationships with clinical research sites in LATAM. May oversee the work of other regional study leads within LATAM. Provide operational and strategic input into study documents such as synopsis, protocol, ICF, CRFs, CRF Completion Guidelines, Study Execution Plans, Clinical Data Review Plan, Clinical Database edit specifications, Clinical Study Report (CSR) development, etc. Oversight of all regional vendors and activities including CROs. Oversee regional start up activities including site selection, enrollment projections and activities driving site activation. Develop region specific the subject recruitment/retention strategy and related initiatives. Oversight of regional TMF ongoing quality review, and final reconciliation of study documents including review of site regulatory documents/packages and obtaining of appropriate site insurance, and/or supervision of team members performing these activities. Development of training materials for study team, investigational sites, and vendors. Proactive management of information sharing with key stakeholders using standardized reports and other mechanisms. Assure clinical studies are compliant with GDPR, ICH/GCP and other regulations as appropriate. Outline regional activation hurdles for team. Participate in RFP development and prepare bid templates to facilitate selection of the CROs/vendors, and/or collaboration/supervision with team members performing these activities. Collaborate with counsel to negotiate and draft research contracts and agreements with CROs/vendors and clinical study sites, as needed. Acts as liaison with Regulatory Affairs to assure adherence to GDPR, GCPs; maintenance of SOPs; and assure site and CRO/vendor audits are completed. Perform regional risk management and implement mitigations. Identify potential study issues and recommend and implement solutions or corrective actions as needed. Create realistic plans that clearly define goals, milestones, responsibilities, and results. Maintain focus on strategic objectives while accomplishing operational goals. Make timely, data-driven decisions. Manage daily activities, assign tasks, goals, and development of direct reports. Other duties as assigned.

Required Education and Experience:

Bachelor's degree required, preferably in scientific discipline. An equivalent combination of relevant education and applicable job experience may be considered. 12 years of prior clinical operations experience preferably with CRO/small biotech experience and approximately 8 years of experience in a supervisory role. Must be able to travel 25-50% of time, may be higher in accordance with project requirements. Computer skills should include proficiency with Microsoft Office suite of software, electronic TMF systems, IXRS and EDC systems. Excellent understanding of drug development process. Experience in clinical trial supply management. Able to make appropriate decisions to move the project(s) forward. Effective verbal and written communication skills. Data flow from sites to data processing, review, and resolution. Analysis and report generation. Knowledge of local regulatory requirements. Ability to handle multiple tasks to meet deadlines in a dynamic environment is essential. Study initiation procedures. Ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action

Travel:

You may be required to travel for up to 25-50% of your time.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior data engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Data Engineer

Brazil

Data Analyst II

Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

As a SQL & Snowflake Engineer, you will play a key role in the full development lifecycle, translating complex data structures into actionable technical insights with a specific focus on Snowflake and SQL queries. You will be responsible for both querying and analyzing large datasets within the Data Lake to support feature development, ensuring seamless data availability from ingestion through to reporting within an Agile framework. Beyond technical execution, you will act as a key contributor in data modeling, actively participating in technical discussions to help the engineering team understand underlying data patterns and quality issues.

Responsibilities and Duties

Digest requirements from the engineering team and specify the implementation of complex SQL queries; Analyze and map underlying data schemas within Snowflake to support application logic; Optimize SQL performance for large-scale data retrieval and reporting; Follow Agile processes and participate actively in data exploration phases; Participate in technical discussions, data quality reviews, and schema design sessions.

Essential Skills

Solid Experience with Snowflake (architecture, warehousing, and data sharing); Strong proficiency in Advanced SQL (CTEs, Window Functions, Stored Procedures); Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and data ingestion tools; Solid experience with version control for database scripts (Git, Liquibase, or dbt).

Highly Desirable Skills

Cloud knowledge (AWS/Azure/GCP) regarding data storage (S3/Blob); Experience with Python or scripting for data manipulation; Familiarity with semi-structured data (JSON, Parquet) with Snowflake.

title: English teacher
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para English teacher em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.

If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.

What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!

In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:

Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.

Minimum Requirements:

Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

Who we are:

Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted advisor to mid-sized to large enterprise accounts. You will build deep relationships, drive adoption of our AI-powered platform, maximize value, and fuel retention and expansion. You will collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers achieve their business goals through clear communication and proactive guidance.

Why Join Our Customer Success Team

This is a strategic, high-impact role where you will own complex accounts, strengthen multi-threaded relationships, and deliver measurable outcomes (NRR, expansion revenue, AI feature adoption). You will work in a collaborative, innovative global environment, partnering with diverse teams to solve real customer challenges and contribute to Sisense's growth in embedded AI analytics.

About You

You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly while staying positive and solution-focused. You are a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor. You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs. You are proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities. You are collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning.

Requirements

3–5 years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent), with proven success managing enterprise/mid-market accounts (Saa S/BI/analytics preferred). Strong track record driving product adoption, value realization, NRR, and revenue expansion. Excellent presentation and executive communication skills; experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships. Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio. Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI. Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions. Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps. Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required; Portuguese a plus). Results-driven with critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus. Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment managing multiple priorities. Bonus: Background in Business Intelligence (BI), embedded analytics, AI/Gen AI enablement, or similar technical solutions.

How You'll Ramp

By Day 30

Complete Customer Success onboarding and training (Sisense values, culture, relationship techniques, product overview, competition, and transformational outcomes). Begin meeting customers, shadowing QBRs/EBRs, and observing how we build relationships and deliver value.

By Day 60

Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals). Deepen product/technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work. Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side-by-side with the team.

By Day 90

Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion). Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement. Become a key contributor to the team's revenue retention and growth goals.

What We Offer

Employment through a partner agency (B2 B). Competitive base salary up to USD 3,500 per month (depending on experience). Eligibility for a quarterly performance bonus. Opportunity to work with a global leader in AI-powered embedded analytics. Flexible remote work with a collaborative international team. Professional development and growth opportunities within Customer Success.

Python/Cloud Platform Developer

Job Summary

We seek an experienced high-performing Python engineer for a position supporting and developing new tools and processes to be used on an on-prem private cloud application. Experience with Kubernetes App Development (design and development of applications that run in Kubernetes clusters); Experience with Postgre SQL as a developer; Experience with Rabbit MQ as a developer.

Garantir a produção eficiente, sustentável e de alta qualidade nas granjas (creches e engorda), por meio da gestão estratégica de pessoas, processos e recursos, assegurando o bem-estar animal, a sanidade do plantel e rentabilidade do negócio, em conformidade com as normas técnicas ambientais e de biossegurança. Dominar o manejo reprodutivo (cobertura, inseminação, diagnóstico de gestação), de crescimento, engorda e nutrição animal, sanidade e medicamentos.

Principais Responsabilidades

Planejar e garantir a execução de todas as etapas: reprodução (cobertura, inseminação artificial, diagnóstico de gestação), controle de ciclo estral, taxas de fertilidade, parto e desmame, gestão de matrizes e leitões. Maternidade, creche e terminação (manejo nutricional por fase, conversão alimentar e ganho de peso, estratégias para redução de perdas, planejamento de abate). Monitorizar indicadores zootécnicos (taxa de parto, mortalidade, ganho de peso, conversão alimentar). Garantir cumprimento das metas de produção e qualidade. Implementar e garantir protocolos sanitários e de vacinação. Controlar uso correto de medicamentos veterinários. Prevenir surtos e agir rapidamente em casos de doença. Assegurar cumprimentos de normas de biossegurança. Liderar, treinar e desenvolver a equipe operacional. Distribuir atividades e garantir disciplina operacional. Acompanhar desempenho e engajamento. Construir cultura de responsabilidade e cuidado. Controlar custos (ração, medicamentos, mão de obra e insumos). Otimizar uso de recursos e reduzir desperdícios. Garantir rentabilidade da operação. Reportar resultados a diretoria com indicadores. Preparar granjas para auditorias e certificações. Garantir bem-estar animal. Atuar junto com fornecedores.

Location: Remote (Work From Home)

Work Hours: Flexible; minimum commitment of 4–5 hours per day

High school or Bachelor's degree in mandatory. Ability to understand and follow detailed annotation guidelines. Basic computer proficiency and familiarity with online tools/platforms. Prior experience in annotation, data labeling, or quality review is an added advantage.

What Makes This Role Exciting

Fully remote opportunity, allowing you to work comfortably from home. Flexible working hours (4–5 hours per day) to suit your schedule. The chance to contribute to cutting-edge AI and Large Language Model (LLM) training initiatives, shaping the future of language technology.

Note:

For this role, you are required to complete the Internal assessment and English assessment within two (2) days from the date it is assigned to you.

title: Global ta manager (contractor role)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Global ta manager (contractor role) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Remote (Based in Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam, or Brazil)

Contract Duration: 6 months (with potential for extension/long-term partnership)

Compensation: Base Rate + Performance-Based Placement Bonus (Earn extra for every successful hire!)

Role Overview

We are stripping away the corporate red tape. This role is built for one thing and one thing only: Pure, High-Velocity Recruitment Delivery.

As a Global TA Manager, you will focus entirely on the frontlines of our international experienced hiring tracks (spanning R& D, Product, and Growth) across the U. S., Europe, LATAM, and Asia. You will be the bridging force between global talent and our HQ team. If you are an independent recruiter who prides yourself on speed, market-mapping accuracy, and closing deals, this is your playground.

What You Will Do-

High-Volume Sourcing & Delivery: Own the end-to-end sourcing and pipeline management for mid-to-senior global roles. You will hunt via Linked In, regional job boards, Git Hub, and cold-outreach to keep our pipelines buzzing. HQ & Candidate Facilitation: Screen global talent, pitch our vision, and seamlessly manage candidates through the interview process, acting as the primary point of contact. Data & Pipeline Transparency: Keep candidate trackers clean and updated, ensuring our global talent pipelines are accurate and moving fast.

The DNA We Are Looking For-

The Baseline (Hard Skills):

Bilingual Mastery (English & Chinese): Both English and Mandarin Chinese must be your fluent working languages. You can interview global talent in flawless English and align instantly with our HQ hiring managers in Chinese. Proven Recruitment Engine: 2-4+ years of recruiting experience in tech, internet, or global expansion enterprises. A proven track record of delivering cross-border talent is a massive plus. Geographic Flexibility: Based in Indonesia, Vietnam, or the U. S., with deep roots in local talent networks but a completely global mindset.

Core Traits (Soft Skills):

The \"Bias for Action\" Delivery Machine: You are fiercely result-oriented, self-driven, and hyper-focused on closing roles. You think on your feet and get things done without waiting for instructions. Insatiable Curiosity & No Guardrails: You don't get trapped by fixed processes. You are eager to experiment with new sourcing hacks, leverage AI tools, and test bold outreach strategies to find that needle in a haystack.

What You Will Get & The Challenges You Will Face

What You Will Get:

Uncapped Earning Potential: On top of your base rate, we offer a highly competitive, milestone-based placement bonus layout. The faster and more effectively you deliver, the more you earn. The Global Flex-Work Playbook: Get hands-on, practical experience inside a highly progressive global flexible-staffing ecosystem. You'll see exactly how a top-tier global tech brand runs an agile, remote talent network. A Trusted Extension of the Crew: No micromanagement. You enjoy the ultimate flexibility of a remote setup while having a world-class global TA team supporting you from behind.

The Challenges You Will Face:

100% Remote Coordination: Working across time zones requires you to be hyper-proactive. You must be comfortable with asynchronous communication and managing your own energy and schedule. Embracing Ambiguity: Global talent markets move fast and change constantly. You need to be comfortable adjusting your sourcing strategy on the fly when a business need shifts.

If you are a bilingual recruitment hustler who is ready to deliver global talent and write your own paycheck via performance bonuses, let's talk. Apply now and let's make a global impact together!

title: Médico nefrologista em telemedicina (com rqe)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Médico nefrologista em telemedicina (com rqe) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO NEFROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"

Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!

A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Nefrologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.

*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH:*

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.

*O QUE PROCURAMOS:*

Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Nefrologia, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.

*PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*

Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Nefrologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação. Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos. Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial. Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas. Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa. Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente. Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças nefrológicas. Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina. Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento. Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas. Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Nefrologia. Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo. Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde. Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado. Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais. Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo. Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes. Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.

REQUISITOS

Formação Acadêmica:

Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM NEFROLOGIA.

Certificações:

Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM); Certificado de Título de Especialista em Nefrologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho do respectivo Estado); Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);

Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Nefrologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina.

Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.

Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.

Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.

Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO

Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.

IMPORTANTE:

MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.

Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Gastroenterologista.

title: Customer success manager
description:

Employment Type: Full-time position employed by a partner agency (3rd party, B2 B)

About Sisense

Sisense is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (An Paa S) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology.

The Role

As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted advisor to mid-sized to large enterprise accounts. You will build deep relationships, drive adoption of our AI-powered platform, maximize value, and fuel retention and expansion. You will collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers achieve their business goals through clear communication and proactive guidance.

Why Join Our Customer Success Team

This is a strategic, high-impact role where you will own complex accounts, strengthen multi-threaded relationships, and deliver measurable outcomes (NRR, expansion revenue, AI feature adoption). You will work in a collaborative, innovative global environment, partnering with diverse teams to solve real customer challenges and contribute to Sisense's growth in embedded AI analytics.

About You

You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly while staying positive and solution-focused. You are a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor. You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs. You are proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities. You are collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning.

Requirements

3–5 years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent), with proven success managing enterprise/mid-market accounts (Saa S/BI/analytics preferred). Strong track record driving product adoption, value realization, NRR, and revenue expansion. Excellent presentation and executive communication skills; experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships. Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio. Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI. Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions. Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps. Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required; Portuguese a plus). Results-driven with critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus. Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment managing multiple priorities. Bonus: Background in Business Intelligence (BI), embedded analytics, AI/Gen AI enablement, or similar technical solutions.

How You'll Ramp

By Day 30

Complete Customer Success onboarding and training (Sisense values, culture, relationship techniques, product overview, competition, and transformational outcomes). Begin meeting customers, shadowing QBRs/EBRs, and observing how we build relationships and deliver value.

By Day 60

Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals). Deepen product/technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work. Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side-by-side with the team.

By Day 90

Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion). Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement. Become a key contributor to the team's revenue retention and growth goals.

What We Offer

Employment through a partner agency (B2 B). Competitive base salary up to USD 3,500 per month (depending on experience). Eligibility for a quarterly performance bonus. Opportunity to work with a global leader in AI-powered embedded analytics. Flexible remote work with a collaborative international team. Professional development and growth opportunities within Customer Success.

Role Overview

We are stripping away the corporate red tape. This role is built for one thing and one thing only: Pure, High-Velocity Recruitment Delivery.

HQ & Candidate Facilitation: Screen global talent, pitch our vision, and seamlessly manage candidates through the interview process, acting as the primary point of contact. Uncapped Earning Potential: On top of your base rate, we offer a highly competitive, milestone-based placement bonus layout. The faster and more effectively you deliver, the more you earn. You'll see exactly how a top-tier global tech brand runs an agile, remote talent network. A Trusted Extension of the Crew: No micromanagement. The Challenges You Will Face:

100% Remote Coordination: Working across time zones requires you to be hyper-proactive. You must be comfortable with asynchronous communication and managing your own energy and schedule. Embracing Ambiguity: Global talent markets move fast and change constantly. You need to be comfortable adjusting your sourcing strategy on the fly when a business need shifts.
