title: Regional study director, latam
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Regional study director, latam em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Crinetics is a pharmaceutical company headquartered in San Diego, California, with a growing presence in Latin America, including an office in Brazil. We are developing much-needed therapies for people with endocrine diseases and endocrine-related tumors. We were founded by a dedicated team of scientists with the simple belief that better therapies developed from rigorous innovation can lead to better lives. Our work continues to make a real difference in the lives of patients. We have a prolific discovery engine and a robust preclinical and clinical development pipeline. We are driven by science with a patient-centric and team-oriented culture. Crinetics is known for its inclusive workplace culture. This is an exciting time to join Crinetics as we expand our operations in Latin America and shape our organization into the world's premier fully integrated endocrine company from discovery to patients. Join our team as we transform the lives of others.

Position Summary:

Please note, the candidate for this role will need to be located in Brazil.

The Regional Study Director, LATAM is responsible for managing the execution of clinical studies and data collection within the LATAM region. The incumbent will serve as a regional clinical study lead who oversees the review, monitoring, and adherence to clinical protocols, as well as managing and building relationships with clinical sites in LATAM. The Regional Study Director, LATAM may oversee other regional study leads within the region to facilitate a streamlined and quality study execution. This role will also work internally and externally with members of the cross-functional study team.

Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities:

These may include but are not limited to:

Provide oversight of clinical research studies for LATAM. Manage and build relationships with clinical research sites in LATAM. May oversee the work of other regional study leads within LATAM. Provide operational and strategic input into study documents such as synopsis, protocol, ICF, CRFs, CRF Completion Guidelines, Study Execution Plans, Clinical Data Review Plan, Clinical Database edit specifications, Clinical Study Report (CSR) development, etc. Oversight of all regional vendors and activities including CROs. Oversee regional start up activities including site selection, enrollment projections and activities driving site activation. Develop region specific the subject recruitment/retention strategy and related initiatives. Oversight of regional TMF ongoing quality review, and final reconciliation of study documents including review of site regulatory documents/packages and obtaining of appropriate site insurance, and/or supervision of team members performing these activities. Development of training materials for study team, investigational sites, and vendors. Proactive management of information sharing with key stakeholders using standardized reports and other mechanisms. Assure clinical studies are compliant with GDPR, ICH/GCP and other regulations as appropriate. Outline regional activation hurdles for team. Participate in RFP development and prepare bid templates to facilitate selection of the CROs/vendors, and/or collaboration/supervision with team members performing these activities. Collaborate with counsel to negotiate and draft research contracts and agreements with CROs/vendors and clinical study sites, as needed. Acts as liaison with Regulatory Affairs to assure adherence to GDPR, GCPs; maintenance of SOPs; and assure site and CRO/vendor audits are completed. Perform regional risk management and implement mitigations. Identify potential study issues and recommend and implement solutions or corrective actions as needed. Create realistic plans that clearly define goals, milestones, responsibilities, and results. Maintain focus on strategic objectives while accomplishing operational goals. Make timely, data-driven decisions. Manage daily activities, assign tasks, goals, and development of direct reports. Other duties as assigned.

Required Education and Experience:

Bachelor's degree required, preferably in scientific discipline. An equivalent combination of relevant education and applicable job experience may be considered. 12 years of prior clinical operations experience preferably with CRO/small biotech experience and approximately 8 years of experience in a supervisory role. Must be able to travel 25-50% of time, may be higher in accordance with project requirements. Computer skills should include proficiency with Microsoft Office suite of software, electronic TMF systems, IXRS and EDC systems. Excellent understanding of drug development process. Experience in clinical trial supply management. Able to make appropriate decisions to move the project(s) forward. Effective verbal and written communication skills. Data flow from sites to data processing, review, and resolution. Analysis and report generation. Knowledge of local regulatory requirements. Ability to handle multiple tasks to meet deadlines in a dynamic environment is essential. Study initiation procedures. Ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action

Travel:

You may be required to travel for up to 25-50% of your time.

Position Overview:

As a Gen AI Data Annotation Analyst, you will play a critical role in developing high-quality datasets that power the next generation of Large Language Models (LLMs). You will evaluate, generate, and refine multi-modal data (text, image, or video) to ensure AI outputs are accurate, safe, and culturally resonant for the Portuguese market.

Key Responsibilities

Multi-Modal Annotation: Label and categorize high-quality training data across text, image, and video formats with surgical precision. Content Generation: Draft grammatically flawless, creative, and factually accurate text in both Portuguese and English, adapting tone and style for specific project needs. Edge-Case Resolution: Apply logical reasoning to resolve ambiguous data scenarios where guidelines may not explicitly cover a specific nuance. Continuous Feedback: Identify and report bugs within internal annotation tools and suggest workflow optimizations. Cross-Functional Sync: Collaborate with Leads and Project Managers to calibrate on quality benchmarks and project pivots.

System Requirements (Mandatory):

Full set of desktop/Laptop with Windows 11 Pro. Bring a compliant device. Windows 11 Pro (Home editions not allowed) or mac OS 12+, 8 GB RAM, 50 GB free disk. Tablets/Chromebooks/phones won't be accepted.

Network: Stable Internet connection, which should have a speed of up to 40 MBPS

Requirements:

Bachelor's degree/ diploma or equivalent educational qualification. Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in annotation tasks, linguistic data handling, or related AI/ML projects. Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms. Strong understanding of language nuances, including grammar, style, and cultural context. Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments. Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training. Familiarity with annotation projects involving sensitive or nuanced content. Prior exposure to Generative AI technologies and principles.

What We Offer:

An innovative and supportive global working environment. Opportunities for continuous learning and growth. Competitive compensation and remote working arrangements. Engagement in impactful projects at the forefront of AI technology.

Join i Merit to be part of shaping high-quality datasets powering the next generation of

Generative AI solutions. If precision, critical analysis, and innovation excite you, we encourage

you to apply!

title: Vacation rental revenue manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Vacation rental revenue manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're hiring a detail-oriented, numbers-driven Vacation Rental Revenue Manager to help Emperor Rentals improve pricing, occupancy, and revenue across our short-term rental portfolio.

This is a fully remote position for candidates currently based in Brazil. You'll work with property performance data, market trends, and pricing tools to help us make smarter revenue decisions every week.

Compensation:

$250 USD per week, paid weekly.

What you'll do:

- Review property performance, pricing, occupancy, ADR, and revenue trends

- Help optimize nightly rates based on seasonality, demand, events, and competitor pricing

- Build and maintain simple revenue reports and forecasts

- Track KPIs and identify opportunities to increase profitability

- Support pricing decisions across Airbnb, short-term rental, and vacation rental channels

- Communicate insights clearly and help the team make data-backed decisions

You may be a great fit if you:

- Are currently based in Brazil and can work remotely

- Are highly analytical, organized, and comfortable working with numbers

- Have strong Excel or Google Sheets skills

- Can spot patterns in data and turn them into practical recommendations

- Are detail-oriented, reliable, and proactive

- Communicate clearly and can work independently

- Are interested in hospitality, Airbnb, short-term rentals, real estate, finance, or revenue management

Nice to have:

- Experience with Airbnb, vacation rentals, hotels, property management, or revenue management

- Experience with pricing tools, market research, dashboards, or financial reporting

- Background in business, finance, economics, analytics, hospitality, or a related field

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys data, pricing strategy, and helping a growing vacation rental company make smarter decisions. If you're based in Brazil and want a remote role where your analysis directly affects business results, we'd love to hear from you.

To apply, please include:

- Your resume

- A short note about your relevant experience

- Your Linked In profile, if available

title: Global ta manager (contractor role)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Global ta manager (contractor role) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Remote (Based in Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam, or Brazil)

Contract Duration: 6 months (with potential for extension/long-term partnership)

Compensation: Base Rate + Performance-Based Placement Bonus (Earn extra for every successful hire!)

Role Overview

We are stripping away the corporate red tape. This role is built for one thing and one thing only: Pure, High-Velocity Recruitment Delivery.

As a Global TA Manager, you will focus entirely on the frontlines of our international experienced hiring tracks (spanning R& D, Product, and Growth) across the U. S., Europe, LATAM, and Asia. You will be the bridging force between global talent and our HQ team. If you are an independent recruiter who prides yourself on speed, market-mapping accuracy, and closing deals, this is your playground.

What You Will Do-

High-Volume Sourcing & Delivery: Own the end-to-end sourcing and pipeline management for mid-to-senior global roles. You will hunt via Linked In, regional job boards, Git Hub, and cold-outreach to keep our pipelines buzzing. HQ & Candidate Facilitation: Screen global talent, pitch our vision, and seamlessly manage candidates through the interview process, acting as the primary point of contact. Data & Pipeline Transparency: Keep candidate trackers clean and updated, ensuring our global talent pipelines are accurate and moving fast.

The DNA We Are Looking For-

The Baseline (Hard Skills):

Bilingual Mastery (English & Chinese): Both English and Mandarin Chinese must be your fluent working languages. You can interview global talent in flawless English and align instantly with our HQ hiring managers in Chinese. Proven Recruitment Engine: 2-4+ years of recruiting experience in tech, internet, or global expansion enterprises. A proven track record of delivering cross-border talent is a massive plus. Geographic Flexibility: Based in Indonesia, Vietnam, or the U. S., with deep roots in local talent networks but a completely global mindset.

Core Traits (Soft Skills):

The \"Bias for Action\" Delivery Machine: You are fiercely result-oriented, self-driven, and hyper-focused on closing roles. You think on your feet and get things done without waiting for instructions. Insatiable Curiosity & No Guardrails: You don't get trapped by fixed processes. You are eager to experiment with new sourcing hacks, leverage AI tools, and test bold outreach strategies to find that needle in a haystack.

What You Will Get & The Challenges You Will Face

What You Will Get:

Uncapped Earning Potential: On top of your base rate, we offer a highly competitive, milestone-based placement bonus layout. The faster and more effectively you deliver, the more you earn. The Global Flex-Work Playbook: Get hands-on, practical experience inside a highly progressive global flexible-staffing ecosystem. You'll see exactly how a top-tier global tech brand runs an agile, remote talent network. A Trusted Extension of the Crew: No micromanagement. You enjoy the ultimate flexibility of a remote setup while having a world-class global TA team supporting you from behind.

The Challenges You Will Face:

100% Remote Coordination: Working across time zones requires you to be hyper-proactive. You must be comfortable with asynchronous communication and managing your own energy and schedule. Embracing Ambiguity: Global talent markets move fast and change constantly. You need to be comfortable adjusting your sourcing strategy on the fly when a business need shifts.

If you are a bilingual recruitment hustler who is ready to deliver global talent and write your own paycheck via performance bonuses, let's talk. Apply now and let's make a global impact together!

title: Motion designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Motion designer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

LEIA A DESCRIÇÃO!

Para se candidatar, preencha o formulário: Wr B1wdp28 NOSSO JEITO DE SER E FAZER

O time da Pay Conductor é feito por pessoas obcecadas por resolver problemas reais de pagamentos: gente que entende que cada décimo de ponto na taxa de aprovação representa milhões na ponta dos nossos clientes.

Acreditamos que orquestração não é só tecnologia, é devolver às empresas o controle sobre o seu próprio dinheiro. Construímos uma plataforma AI-driven que conecta adquirentes, gateways e meios de pagamento em uma única camada inteligente, e estamos só começando.

Se você quer fazer parte do time que está redefinindo a infraestrutura de pagamentos do Brasil, é aqui.

E aí, quer construir o futuro dos pagamentos com a gente? SOBRE A VAGA

O time de Marketing da Pay Conductor é responsável por traduzir uma plataforma técnica e robusta em uma marca desejada por empreendedores digitais, varejistas, e-commerces e líderes do mercado financeiro.

A sua missão como Motion Designer será transformar conceitos complexos, como roteamento inteligente, taxa de aprovação, antifraude, recuperação de vendas e inteligência de pagamentos, em vídeos, animações e peças visuais que prendem atenção, explicam com clareza e fortalecem a percepção da marca.

Buscamos uma pessoa criativa, detalhista e com repertório visual forte. Alguém que entenda que motion não é apenas "fazer elementos se mexerem", mas construir narrativa, ritmo e impacto visual.

Você vai trabalhar de perto com Marketing, Conteúdo, Design e fundadores, criando assets para redes sociais, campanhas, materiais comerciais, eventos, lançamentos e apresentações. Mais do que executar briefings, queremos alguém que proponha caminhos visuais, teste formatos e ajude a construir uma marca forte, moderna e memorável. VOCÊ TERÁ ENTRE SUAS RESPONSABILIDADES:

Criar vídeos e animações para os canais oficiais da Pay Conductor, como Linked In, Instagram, You Tube, site e novos canais conforme estratégia. Desenvolver motion graphics para posts, carrosséis animados, reels, vídeos curtos, campanhas e materiais institucionais. Transformar roteiros e conceitos técnicos em animações claras, bonitas e fáceis de entender. Animar ícones, gráficos, interfaces, fluxos de pagamento, dashboards, transações e elementos visuais da marca. Apoiar a produção de vídeos para campanhas de mídia paga, eventos, lançamentos e ações comerciais. Criar variações de peças animadas para testes de performance e diferentes formatos de distribuição. Editar vídeos curtos com ritmo, cortes, legendas, trilhas, transições e acabamento profissional. Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com Design e Conteúdo para garantir coesão visual e narrativa da marca. Ajudar a evoluir a linguagem visual da Pay Conductor em movimento, respeitando identidade, paleta, tipografia e estilo da marca. Trazer referências visuais, tendências de motion, formatos de redes sociais e ideias para elevar a qualidade criativa dos conteúdos. VOCÊ AGREGARÁ SE POSSUIR: Portfólio com projetos de motion design, edição de vídeo, animação ou peças em movimento. Domínio de ferramentas como After Effects, Premiere, Illustrator, Photoshop, Figma, Cap Cut ou similares. Boa noção de composição visual, ritmo, hierarquia, transição, storytelling e acabamento. Sensibilidade estética para criar peças modernas, limpas e com aparência premium. Capacidade de transformar temas técnicos em narrativas visuais simples e interessantes. Organização para lidar com múltiplas demandas em uma rotina dinâmica de marketing. Repertório ativo de referências visuais, redes sociais, design, tecnologia e cultura digital. Vontade de aprender sobre fintech, pagamentos, e-commerce e inteligência artificial. VOCÊ SE DESTACARÁ SE TIVER: Experiência prévia com marcas B2 B, Saa S, fintech, tecnologia, meios de pagamento ou e-commerce. Experiência com animação de UI, dashboards, fluxos de produto e interfaces digitais. Conhecimento em Lottie, Rive, Cinema 4 D, Blender ou outras ferramentas de animação/3 D. Experiência criando vídeos para campanhas de performance, anúncios e testes de criativos. Noções de design gráfico, direção de arte e criação de conceitos visuais. Familiaridade com ferramentas de IA aplicadas à criação, edição, storyboard ou geração de assets. Repertório de marcas com identidade visual forte, linguagem tecnológica e comunicação diferenciada. O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

Esperamos uma pessoa com olhar apurado, autonomia criativa e vontade real de construir.

Alguém que consiga pegar um tema complexo e transformar em uma animação clara. Que saiba equilibrar estética com comunicação. Que entenda quando uma peça precisa ser mais institucional, mais comercial, mais educativa ou mais social-first.

Na Pay Conductor, você terá espaço para propor, testar e evoluir a linguagem visual de uma marca que está entrando em uma categoria nova e estratégica para o mercado brasileiro.

Para se candidatar, preencha o formulário: Wr B1wdp28

title: Senior machine learning engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior machine learning engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next‐generation AI‐native B2 B platform for hospitality. We're looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who is excited about the craft of machine learning—especially the mathematical and statistical foundations behind models—and who can turn that depth into solutions that scale in real-world use. If you're someone who enjoys choosing the right model for the problem, validating it rigorously, and improving it through iteration, you'll feel at home here.

This is an opportunity for an engineer who wants to grow into a future architect, help define large-scale backend systems, and become a true technical champion within the team. If you are passionate about modern backend engineering, clean architecture, and scalable distributed systems, you'll love working with us.

What you'll do

Design, train, and improve statistical and machine learning models for real product use cases. Apply strong fundamentals in probability, statistics, and modeling to make sound decisions on approach and evaluation. Build scalable ML solutions that can be used reliably in production environments. Develop capabilities to support agent-like experiences within our platform (e.g., intelligent workflows, tool-using behaviors, retrieval patterns, guardrails). Define and monitor meaningful model metrics, run error analysis, and iterate based on results.

What we're looking for

We're intentionally not treating this as a checklist. If you're strong in the fundamentals and have built real ML systems, we'd love to hear from you.

You'll be successful in this role if you have:

Strong knowledge across a broad range of machine learning algorithms (supervised/unsupervised methods, ensembles, linear models, tree-based methods, deep learning basics) and the judgment to choose appropriately. Solid grounding in statistics and mathematical reasoning (e.g., bias/variance tradeoffs, uncertainty, evaluation design). Experience building ML solutions in practice: data understanding, feature design, training, evaluation, and iteration. Strong Python skills and the ability to write clear, maintainable code. Familiarity with standard ML tooling (e.g., scikit-learn, Py Torch/Tensor Flow).

Nice to have (not required)

Experience with NLP and/or LLMs (helpful, but not a core requirement). Exposure to ML-related capabilities on AWS, such as training/inference workflows or managed ML services (e.g., Sage Maker), and working with storage/data access patterns commonly used for ML. Experience implementing or integrating vector search / embedding-based retrieval.

Why Join Us

You will work in a modern, AI-native engineering culture building applied machine learning systems that ship. You'll have the opportunity to design mathematically grounded models, turn them into scalable product capabilities, and help define how intelligent agents live inside our platform. This role is ideal for someone who loves ML fundamentals, enjoys solving real problems end-to-end, and wants to grow into a senior technical leader shaping our ML direction.

Equal Opportunity

Directful is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of any protected characteristic.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor aem, senior em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who Are We.

Newfold Digital is a leading web technology company serving nearly seven million customers globally. Established in 2021 through the combination of leading web services providers Endurance Web Presence and Group, our portfolio of brands includes: Bluehost, Big Rock, Reseller Club, Crazy Domains, Host Gator, Network Solutions, , and many others.

We help customers of all sizes build a digital presence that delivers results. With our extensive product offerings and personalized support, we take pride in collaborating with our customers to serve their online presence needs.

What you'll do & how you'll make your mark.

Develop and maintain reusable front-end components in Adobe Experience Manager (AEM). Work with AEM components and templates, including integrating front-end code with AEM's rendering system. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including designers, back-end developers to deliver digital experiences.

Who you are & what you'll need to succeed.

Advanced English skills. Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, Java Script/Type Script, and responsive web design principles. Experience integrating Front-end code with AEM components, templates, and workflows. Familiarity with AEM Sightly (HTL) and Sling models and AEM ecosystem. Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment.

Why you'll love us

title: Ai quality analyst (portgugal portuguese )
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai quality analyst (portgugal portuguese ) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description:

Million Logics is a trusted Oracle Partner and global leader in IT solutions, with operations in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. Specialising in innovative and scalable services, Million Logics empowers enterprises through data & AI, cloud solutions, IT consulting, and custom application development. With a team of 85+ AI/ML experts, we deliver tailored solutions that foster digital transformation and operational excellence. We are committed to client success. We blend world-class technical expertise with strategic insight to deliver results.

Role Overview:

As an AI quality analyst, you will evaluate a new personalisation feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and You Tube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigour. You will actively design prompts from your personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalised responses, evaluating dimensions such as grounding, integration, and helpfulness.

Offer Details:

Duration of Contract: 12 months Pay: $1500 per month (net/take-home) Mode of work: Fully Remote Number of Positions: 20 Must have fluency in Portugal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese)

Key Qualifications:

Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portugal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese) with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project. Personal Account Usage: Willing to use computer science, primary personal Google account (not a testing account), and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment. Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team. Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate the ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalisation quality. Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities. Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalisation concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalisation, poor inferences, and forced connections. Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (Sx S) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and over-narrating. Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers. Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Technical Setup: Desktop/laptop set up with a good internet connection.

Description:

In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalised AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve: Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilise your personal information and experiences. Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalisation was appropriately applied. Analysing responses for grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations. Assessing integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"over-narrating\". Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (Sx S) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable. Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation. Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilised. Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.

Education & Experience:

BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., policy, law, ethics, linguistics, journalism, computer science, or a related analytical field). Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.

Additional Details:

Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week, with 4 hours of overlap with PST. Engagement type: Contractor Engagement Length: 12 months

title: Senior python engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior python engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company:

Windsor.ai has been founded in 2017 in Zürich, , we are growing fast. We connect data from 300+ sources (Facebook Ads, Google Ads, Hub Spot, Salesforce, Tik Tok) to 30+ destinations (Looker Studio, Google Sheets, Big Query, Snowflake, and LLMs like Chat GPT and Claude). Our customers include Puma, Audi, UBS, Asics and many more.

We are building a platform that makes it easy to connect any data source to any destination. There is more data being generated in the world every day, but the big problem is that the number of tools is also increasing so data must be updated in multiple systems and tools. We are solving this problem.

Role: We are looking for a Senior Python Engineer to join our team, focusing on Python services, API integrations, scalability, and production reliability.

Our Team:

Our team has around 30 people working remotely across Europe. We're a highly technical team, and even our sales and marketing colleagues are comfortable writing at least some SQL. Our software engineers are specialised in backend with Python and frontend with React

Product:

We have built a data platform connecting to more than 300 different API's. Big part of our work is dealing with all the complexity and variations in all the different API's and scalability.

Technology:

We are mostly programming in python and using quite advanced features of python. Most common tools we use:

Python : flask, threads, pytest-xdist, pylint Redis, postgres Linux, docker React, redux for frontend

Role Requirements:

4+ years of programming experience. Strong expertise in Python, with experience building and maintaining complex, production-grade systems Good programming knowledge (OOP, mutable/immutable types etc.) Solid experience working in Linux-based development and production environments Enjoy working in a fast-moving organization where you can have a real impact Fluency in English is mandatory

How we work:

We usually plan our work in two weeks intervals but the plan is not super strict so there might be some priorities changed during the sprint. We use Taiga, Gitlab, CI/CD lots of pytest and merge request reviews.

Location: Remote

Windsor.ai is a global team of data engineers and analysts who strive to make data integration effortless and insights easy to extract to everyone. We help businesses of all sizes connect their marketing and sales data, automate reporting, and measure what drives the greatest impact.

Requirements added by the job poster

• Accept a background check

• 4+ years of work experience with Python (Programming Language)

Title: Senior Specialist, Global ICSR Case Processing & QC

Department: Global Patient Safety

Overview:

Seeking an experienced Senior Specialist in Global ICSR Case Processing & QC to independently manage the processing and quality control of individual case safety reports (ICSRs), ensuring regulatory compliance and excellence in data accuracy, completeness, and quality. The role includes SAE reconciliation, meeting compliance and productivity targets, and supporting onboarding and training for new team members.

Key Responsibilities:

ICSR Case Processing: Manage case processing and quality control of ICSRs from diverse sources (e.g., clinical trials, post-market, literature) to ensure timely, accurate submissions to regulatory authorities. SAE Reconciliation: Perform SAE reconciliations between safety and clinical databases, track progress, resolve issues, and escalate when necessary. Quality & Compliance: Adhere to KPI and quality metrics, ensuring productivity and process improvement within ICSR management. Decision-Making: Execute decisions in line with operational policies, SOPs, and work instructions. Vendor/CRO Coordination: Ensure ICSR activities align with PV agreements and contracts. Training & Onboarding: Develop and update training materials, onboard new team members, provide feedback, and support the onboarding process.

Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in life sciences, clinical medicine, nursing, pharmacy, or equivalent experience; advanced degree preferred. Proficiency with Argus safety database and MS Office Suite. Minimum 2 years of experience in drug safety/pharmacovigilance or relevant clinical experience. Preferred 5-8 years of experience Strong understanding of global regulatory requirements (e.g., ICH, FDA, EMA, MHRA) for pharmacovigilance reporting. Excellent communication, problem-solving, time management, and attention to detail. Global cultural awareness and collaborative mindset.

title: Médico nefrologista em telemedicina (com rqe)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Médico nefrologista em telemedicina (com rqe) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO NEFROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"

Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!

A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Nefrologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.

*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH:*

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.

*O QUE PROCURAMOS:*

Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Nefrologia, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.

*PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*

Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Nefrologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação. Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos. Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial. Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas. Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa. Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente. Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças nefrológicas. Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina. Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento. Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas. Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Nefrologia. Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo. Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde. Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado. Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais. Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo. Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes. Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.

REQUISITOS

Formação Acadêmica:

Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM NEFROLOGIA.

Certificações:

Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM); Certificado de Título de Especialista em Nefrologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho do respectivo Estado); Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);

Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Nefrologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina.

Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.

Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.

Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.

Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO

Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.

IMPORTANTE:

MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.

Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Gastroenterologista.

Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Nefrologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação. Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos. Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial. Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas. Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa. Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente. Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças nefrológicas. Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina. Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento. Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas. Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Nefrologia. Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo. Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde. Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado. Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais. Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo. Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes. Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.

REQUISITOS

Formação Acadêmica:

Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM NEFROLOGIA.

Certificações:

Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM); Certificado de Título de Especialista em Nefrologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho do respectivo Estado); Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);

Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Nefrologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina.

Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.

Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.

Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.

Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO

Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.

IMPORTANTE:

MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.

Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Gastroenterologista.

description:

Senior. Net Engineer

Resume: English Version only. Resume should have detailed discussion of project overview and job description. Highlight the following if applicable - Maui (Blazor, Razor, Xamarin); Healthcare projects; HIPAA knowledge; SAAS projects; US-based projects

Role: Full time contractor; Fully Remote

Work Hours: US time zone

Location: Brazil

Rate: R$20,000-22,000 per month

About the Company

We are a forward-thinking technology organization dedicated to developing innovative software solutions that improve outcomes for clients and end-users. Our engineering team designs, builds, and maintains scalable, high-quality applications that drive efficiency and innovation across industries. We are seeking an experienced Level III Software Engineer (contractor) to join our distributed team, contributing to complex projects with a focus on code quality, security, and collaboration.

Position Overview

As a Level III Software Engineer (contractor), you will apply your technical expertise to deliver high-quality code for moderately to highly complex projects. Working remotely with a U. S.-based team, you'll gain deep system knowledge and contribute to an Agile development workflow using Azure Dev Ops.

You will begin with automated testing and peer reviews, expanding into broader development tasks by months 2–3. The role will continue to evolve based on your strengths and project needs, while maintaining rigorous adherence to coding and security standards.

Key Responsibilities

Product Design & Development: Collaborate with stakeholders to design and implement software solutions aligned with technical and business objectives. Code Contributions: Write, optimize, and maintain efficient code, including enhancement of existing codebases, beginning around months 3–4. Testing & Quality: Design and implement automated end-to-end (E2 E) tests (e.g., using Microsoft Playwright) to ensure feature stability—especially during the first 6–9 months. Peer Reviews: Participate in pre-release feature reviews and early post-release bug analysis (first 90 days), transitioning to broader ownership over time. Agile Workflow Participation: Actively contribute to sprints, pull requests, and releases within a 2-week sprint / 6-week release cycle using Azure Dev Ops. Collaboration: Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical team members across multiple time zones.

Qualifications

Experience

5–8 years of software engineering experience with a demonstrated record of success on complex projects.

Technical Skills

Proficiency in C# ASP. NET (. NET 8) for web applications and APIs. Experience with. NET MAUI and Blazor Web Applications (. NET 8), leveraging web expertise for cross-platform or mobile development. Familiarity with Microsoft Azure services, including Azure App Service, Azure SQL, and Azure Storage. Strong understanding of modern development tools (e.g., Visual Studio, Git, Azure Dev Ops). Knowledge of secure coding practices and general cybersecurity principles. Experience with cloud platforms and Agile methodologies.

Soft Skills

Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities. Strong written and verbal communication skills for remote collaboration. Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team environment.

Preferred

Experience with regulated or data-sensitive software environments (e.g., healthcare, financial services, HIPAA, PHI). Prior experience conducting pull-request reviews and participating in Agile sprints.

What We Offer

Opportunity to work on impactful, large-scale technology projects. Collaborative, high-performance engineering culture focused on quality and innovation. Flexible remote work environment with a structured onboarding process for success.

How We Work

Agile Workflow: Two-week sprints within a six-week release cycle, including daily stand-ups (3:00 PM CT), sprint planning, and reviews. Code Standards: Strict adherence to best practices, peer reviews, and security testing (e.g., OWASP, Detectify). Tool Stack: Azure Dev Ops, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, Datadog, Microsoft Playwright, and related technologies. Team Culture: A focus on accountability, collaboration, and excellence in delivery.

description:

We are a leading brand in health supplements for women over 40. Our mission is to improve the quality of life for women going through menopause by solving real, everyday challenges—weight gain, hot flashes, insomnia, mood shifts, and more.

We're looking for a Creative Strategist with strong persuasive advertising and copywriting expertise to own the ideation and messaging that drives performance. You'll turn customer insights, performance data, and market awareness into high-converting creative angles, scripts, and messaging systems that scale.

Responsibilities

Creative Strategy

Contribute to the development of creative strategy for paid social, grounded in direct-response principles Translate performance data, customer research, and competitive insights into effective copy frameworks and angles Support the creation of ad concepts and scalable creative approaches Participate in brainstorming and help shape a testing roadmap of angles, messages, and formats based on clear hypotheses Help maintain creative standards to ensure consistent brand voice and persuasive quality across ads, landing pages, and funnels

Performance & Media Buying Integration

Use platform learnings and audience behavior to shape creative testing and copy direction. Build feedback loops so creative evolves weekly based on performance data across ads

AI & Creative Innovation

Experience leveraging AI tools to accelerate creative research and performance testing. Proven ability to prepare structured briefs and prompts for AI-generated ad creatives (scripts, hooks, visuals, UGC-style ads).

Qualifications

Experience in creative strategy, performance creative, or e-commerce marketing. Hands-on experience with direct-response copywriting Direct experience with women's wellness, supplements, or health-related products strongly preferred. Proven ability to prepare structured briefs/prompts for AI-generated ad creatives (e.g., scripts, hooks, visuals, UGC-style ads). Strong portfolio of paid social creative with proven ROI. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Working hours

6am - 2pm EST (Monday - Friday) Fully-remote

Compensation

$3,500 to $5,000/month

If you think you might be a good fit, please apply.

Aqui você vai fazer parte de um #timaço que tem a missão de revolucionar o mercado da beleza através de soluções digitais completas para estabelecimentos do ramo, que vão desde a gestão do negócio até serviços financeiros, ferramentas de fidelização, agendamento online e muito mais!

Você será responsável por manter e aprimorar pipelines de CI/CD, gerenciar a infraestrutura na AWS, acompanhar métricas de monitoramento, atuar na resolução de incidentes e liderar a comunicação técnica com times internos e parceiros.

Dá uma olhada no seu papel nessa #revolução:

Garantir a confiabilidade e estabilidade dos ambientes produtivos e de homologação; Promover boas práticas de automação e infraestrutura como código (Ia C); Otimizar o ciclo de deploy e monitoramento contínuo; Conduzir comunicações técnicas com fornecedores e stakeholders; Inspirar confiança e ser referência técnica dentro do time.

O que você precisa para o #match perfeito:

Experiência sólida com AWS (ECS, EC2, RDS, ALB, WAF, Cloud Watch, S3); Conhecimento em Infra as Code (Terraform e/ou Cloud Formation); Experiência com pipelines CI/CD (Git Hub Actions ou similares); Conhecimento em monitoramento, logging e automação de alertas; Experiência com Docker e ambientes Linux e Windows Server; Conhecimento de redes, DNS, SSL, balanceamento e segurança em nuvem; Gostar de compartilhar conhecimentos e de trabalhar com equipe colaborativa.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

Experiência com monitoramento avançado (Datadog, New Relic, Prometheus, Grafana); Conhecimento em scripts de automação (Python, Bash, Power Shell); Vivência com ECS Fargate e pipelines multiambiente; Experiência em otimização de custos em AWS; Certificações AWS ou Dev Ops.

Saca só o que OFERECEMOS:

100% Home office;

Contratação CLT (40 horas semanais);

Auxílio home office;

Vale alimentação e vale refeição no cartão flexível;

Plano de Saúde Sul América (custo zero para o colaborador);

Plano Odonto Sul América (custo zero para o colaborador);

Total Pass (plano academia);

Incentivo ao Desenvolvimento: PDI, Capacitações, Feedbacks, Desconto com Faculdades e Cursos de Idiomas;

Bônus por indicação de talentos;

Day off de aniversário e tempo de casa.

Todas as nossas vagas são abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

Na Trinks, valorizamos a melhor versão de você mesmo, com incentivos e autonomia para trabalhar, desenvolver e implementar ideias.

E aí, se identificou? Então vem com a gente impulsionar e conectar os negócios de beleza

title: Senior python engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior python engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company:

Windsor.ai has been founded in 2017 in Zürich, , we are growing fast. We connect data from 300+ sources (Facebook Ads, Google Ads, Hub Spot, Salesforce, Tik Tok) to 30+ destinations (Looker Studio, Google Sheets, Big Query, Snowflake, and LLMs like Chat GPT and Claude). Our customers include Puma, Audi, UBS, Asics and many more.

We are building a platform that makes it easy to connect any data source to any destination. There is more data being generated in the world every day, but the big problem is that the number of tools is also increasing so data must be updated in multiple systems and tools. We are solving this problem.

Role: We are looking for a Senior Python Engineer to join our team, focusing on Python services, API integrations, scalability, and production reliability.

Our Team:

Our team has around 30 people working remotely across Europe. We're a highly technical team, and even our sales and marketing colleagues are comfortable writing at least some SQL. Our software engineers are specialised in backend with Python and frontend with React

Product:

We have built a data platform connecting to more than 300 different API's. Big part of our work is dealing with all the complexity and variations in all the different API's and scalability.

Technology:

We are mostly programming in python and using quite advanced features of python. Most common tools we use:

Python : flask, threads, pytest-xdist, pylint Redis, postgres Linux, docker React, redux for frontend

Role Requirements:

4+ years of programming experience. Strong expertise in Python, with experience building and maintaining complex, production-grade systems Good programming knowledge (OOP, mutable/immutable types etc.) Solid experience working in Linux-based development and production environments Enjoy working in a fast-moving organization where you can have a real impact Fluency in English is mandatory

How we work:

We usually plan our work in two weeks intervals but the plan is not super strict so there might be some priorities changed during the sprint. We use Taiga, Gitlab, CI/CD lots of pytest and merge request reviews.

Location: Remote

Windsor.ai is a global team of data engineers and analysts who strive to make data integration effortless and insights easy to extract to everyone. We help businesses of all sizes connect their marketing and sales data, automate reporting, and measure what drives the greatest impact.

Requirements added by the job poster

• Accept a background check

• 4+ years of work experience with Python (Programming Language)

title: Full stack engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full stack engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Freight Hero

Freight Hero is an AI-native services company built to support the freight brokerage industry, which is in dire need of it. Robin, our autonomous AI agent, handles back-office work end to end. Our Heroes, a sharp human-in-the-loop team, catch the edge cases. Brokers pay us per load, see ROI in weeks, and reassign or eliminate the teams they used to rent.

We are backed by incredible investors, including Andrew Ng's AI Fund and supply chain specialists Dynamo Ventures.

The thesis is proven. What is next is growth, and that means building a team of incredible people around us to push the company to the next level. The product is real, the customers are real, the revenue is real, and joining now means shaping how this company runs.

About the Role

This is a senior full‐stack engineering role focused on building and scaling the core Freight Hero platform. You will work across backend services, integrations, internal tools, and customer-facing features, primarily using Node.js, Type Script, React, and AWS.

You won't be inheriting a legacy monolith. You'll be contributing to a modern, event‐driven, AI‐powered system and helping us scale it as customer adoption accelerates.

You'll collaborate closely with product, AI, and customer teams to translate real operational workflows into robust, reliable software. As the team grows, you'll have opportunities to mentor others, influence architecture, and shape engineering best practices.

What Success Looks Like

A successful engineer in this role:

Builds scalable, reliable services in Node.js/Type Script that integrate deeply with customer systems. Designs and maintains AWS‐native infrastructure that is observable, secure, and cost‐efficient. Works cross‐functionally to understand customer workflows and translate them into technical solutions. Ships high‐quality features quickly while maintaining engineering excellence. Identifies opportunities to automate, optimize, and expand the platform. Contributes to a culture of ownership, clarity, and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities:

Full Stack Engineering

Build backend services, APIs, and workflow engines using Node.js + Type Script. Contribute to frontend components when needed using React + Vue JS. Implement robust testing, observability, and CI/CD practices.

AWS native Architecture

Design and maintain cloud infrastructure using AWS services such as Lambda, RDS, Dynamo DB, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, and more. Ensure systems are scalable, secure, and cost‐optimized.

Systems Integration

Build integrations with TMS platforms, carrier systems, and customer‐specific tools.

Work with internal teams to understand operational processes and translate them into scalable technical solutions.

AI Forward Development

Collaborate with AI engineers to embed LLM‐powered workflows into the product. Use AI tools to accelerate development, improve code quality, and automate repetitive tasks.

Identify opportunities to expand AI‐driven automation across the platform.

Collaboration & Impact

Work closely with product, operations, and customer success to deeply understand customer needs. Participate in technical discussions, architectural decisions, and roadmap planning. Help establish engineering best practices as the team grows.

What We Are Looking For

8+ years of professional software engineering experience. Strong expertise in Node.js, Type Script, React, and AWS cloud architecture. Experience building distributed systems, event‐driven architectures, or workflow automation. Comfortable working across the stack (backend‐heavy, but able to contribute to frontend). Strong communicator who collaborates well with non‐technical teams. High ownership mindset - you thrive in fast‐moving, ambiguous environments. Curiosity about AI and eagerness to leverage it in your day‐to‐day work. Bonus: experience in freight tech, logistics, or integrations with TMS/ERP systems.

Why Freight Hero

Built at the intersection of AI and logistics, one of the most impactful spaces in B2 B tech. Work with a team that moves fast, thinks big, and cares deeply about customer outcomes. Opportunities to mentor, influence architecture, and grow as the engineering team scales. Competitive compensation with performance incentives. Fully remote with a collaborative, high‐performance culture.

title: Product owner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Product owner em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Product Owner – Client Onboarding & Customer Success

Remote (Brazil-based) | Supporting UK & US stakeholders | 8,000 - 10,000 BRL

We're proud to be partnering with an innovative, fast-growing Saa S business that is transforming how organisations deliver professional online auction experiences under their own brand. Following a period of impressive growth, our client is now looking to appoint a Product Owner – Client Onboarding & Customer Success to play a pivotal role in their next phase.

This is a unique opportunity to sit at the intersection of product, clients, and operations—owning the journey from signed deal through to successful platform adoption.

The Opportunity

As Product Owner, you'll take the lead in ensuring new clients are seamlessly onboarded and set up for success from day one. Working closely with senior leadership, engineering, and customer success, you'll help clients quickly reach their first live auction and build long-term confidence using the platform.

This is a hands-on, highly collaborative role where you'll:

Guide clients through onboarding and implementation Translate real-world client needs into clear product requirements Support ongoing customer success and operational excellence Play a key role in product testing and continuous improvement

What You'll Be Doing

Owning the end-to-end onboarding journey from sales handover to go-live Acting as a trusted partner to clients, supporting early use and best practice Gathering and defining technical and operational requirements Collaborating with engineering to ensure smooth configuration and delivery Testing new features and ensuring releases are client-ready Feeding real client insight back into the product roadmap

What We're Looking For

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai quality analyst (portgugal portuguese ) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description:

Million Logics is a trusted Oracle Partner and global leader in IT solutions, with operations in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. Specialising in innovative and scalable services, Million Logics empowers enterprises through data & AI, cloud solutions, IT consulting, and custom application development. With a team of 85+ AI/ML experts, we deliver tailored solutions that foster digital transformation and operational excellence. We are committed to client success. We blend world-class technical expertise with strategic insight to deliver results.

Role Overview:

As an AI quality analyst, you will evaluate a new personalisation feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and You Tube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigour. You will actively design prompts from your personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalised responses, evaluating dimensions such as grounding, integration, and helpfulness.

Offer Details:

Duration of Contract: 12 months Pay: $1500 per month (net/take-home) Mode of work: Fully Remote Number of Positions: 20 Must have fluency in Portugal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese)

Key Qualifications:

Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portugal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese) with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project. Personal Account Usage: Willing to use computer science, primary personal Google account (not a testing account), and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment. Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team. Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate the ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalisation quality. Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities. Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalisation concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalisation, poor inferences, and forced connections. Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (Sx S) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and over-narrating. Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers. Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Technical Setup: Desktop/laptop set up with a good internet connection.

Description:

In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalised AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve: Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilise your personal information and experiences. Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalisation was appropriately applied. Analysing responses for grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations. Assessing integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"over-narrating\". Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (Sx S) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable. Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation. Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilised. Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.

Education & Experience:

BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., policy, law, ethics, linguistics, journalism, computer science, or a related analytical field). Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.

Additional Details:

Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week, with 4 hours of overlap with PST. Engagement type: Contractor Engagement Length: 12 months

title: Especialista em desenvolvimento de negócios (b2b)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Especialista em desenvolvimento de negócios (b2b) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

NÓS AJUDAMOS AS PESSOAS A ATINGIR SEUS OBJETIVOS NO MERCADO FINANCEIRO! TOPA VIR COM A GENTE?

Somos uma fintech que une tecnologia e inovação em um mercado que não para de crescer!

Desde 2019, o aplicativo Grana simplifica o cálculo de Imposto de Renda para investidores da bolsa. Hoje, estamos expandindo nossa atuação com novos produtos:

Grana Pro, voltado para contadores e assessores que atendem investidores; Grana Smart, que utiliza Open Finance e Inteligência Artificial para dar mais clareza e controle sobre a vida financeira das pessoas.

Estamos em um momento de construção e crescimento, abrindo novas frentes, testando caminhos e evoluindo nossos produtos com base em quem usa.

Conheça mais sobre nossa proposta e funcionalidades em:

DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

O Grana Pro é nossa frente B2 B e está em fase de construção. Buscamos uma pessoa para atuar na linha de frente desse crescimento, ajudando a desenvolver e escalar a base de clientes.

Essa posição envolve desde a prospecção e apresentação do produto até o acompanhamento do cliente ao longo da jornada, com um papel ativo na construção da estratégia comercial e na evolução do produto.

Aqui, você terá autonomia, contato direto com o mercado e a oportunidade real de construir algo do zero.

Se isso te descreve, essa vaga é para você!

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

Mapear e prospectar ativamente contadores e assessores — levantamento de mercado, abordagem por e-mail, Linked In, Whats App e telefone, campanhas de marketing; Apresentar o produto em demonstrações por vídeo ou presencialmente, conectando as funcionalidades às dores reais de cada cliente; Acompanhar o funil de ponta a ponta, analisar a conversão e propor ações concretas para melhorar os números; Fazer o acompanhamento pós-venda, garantir que o cliente use o produto e vire referência; Dar retorno direto sobre o produto com base no que vê no dia a dia;

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

Experiência em vendas consultivas ou gestão de contas B2 B; Facilidade para entender e explicar produtos com alguma complexidade (fiscal, tributária ou financeira); Perfil que constrói carteira de clientes do zero, sem esperar o contato chegar; Boa comunicação escrita e verbal; Capacidade de olhar a estratégia ampla para definir caminhos e, ao mesmo tempo, se envolver nos detalhes operacionais. Mentalidade \"0 a 1\": perfil auto-motivado que tenha paixão por construir e vontade de desenvolver uma prática de vendas B2 B do zero.

Será um diferencial:

Conhecimento pessoal ou profissional em investimentos (especialmente bolsa de valores); Experiência com contadores e assessores de contabilidade.

INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

Salário a combinar

Contrato PJ

Gympass

Day Off de Aniversário

Home Office (trabalho remoto)

No dress code (sem código de vestimenta)

Muito aprendizado e desenvolvimento!

Na Grana Capital, acreditamos que a diversidade enriquece nosso ambiente de trabalho e impulsiona nossa missão. Aqui, todas as pessoas são bem-vindas para se candidatar.

title: Business development manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business development manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us:

Temu is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Business Development Managerto join our team. As a rapidly growing company, we are looking for talented individuals committed to helping us achieve our goals. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with a team of driven individuals dedicated to making a difference in the industry.

Responsibilities

Proactively recruit and develop effective local partnerships with merchandise partners, manufacturers, and brands. Focus on categories selections to increase overall value, in alignment with business and customer needs. Assist merchandise partners in establishing themselves on the platform and their growth. Guide merchandise partners in developing comprehensive plans including market positioning, product planning, brand marketing, and operational strategies. Propose innovative ideas based on the current status of the categories, as well as create and implement projects through resource integration and merchant guidance. Conduct industry analysis reports, explore potential customer needs through data analysis, and adjust strategies accordingly based on market trends.

Required skills / Minimum Qualifications

5+ years of operational experience, including but not limited to experience in brand management or platform operations. Extensive connections and relationships with local seller and vendor networks is a plus. Strong data analysis skills, able to analyze industry trends and project management through data, and summarize conclusions. Possesses market exploration and marketing innovation capabilities, capable of guiding overall merchant marketing plans. Excellent problem-solving skills, self-motivation, ability to think strategically and adapt quickly to changes. Ability to work under pressure and manage logistics during high-demand periods.

Equal Employment Statement

At Temu, we are proud to be an employer that builds a diverse community. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity.

Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

title: Senior specialist, global icsr
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior specialist, global icsr em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Title: Senior Specialist, Global ICSR Case Processing & QC

Department: Global Patient Safety

Overview:

Seeking an experienced Senior Specialist in Global ICSR Case Processing & QC to independently manage the processing and quality control of individual case safety reports (ICSRs), ensuring regulatory compliance and excellence in data accuracy, completeness, and quality. The role includes SAE reconciliation, meeting compliance and productivity targets, and supporting onboarding and training for new team members.

Key Responsibilities:

ICSR Case Processing: Manage case processing and quality control of ICSRs from diverse sources (e.g., clinical trials, post-market, literature) to ensure timely, accurate submissions to regulatory authorities. SAE Reconciliation: Perform SAE reconciliations between safety and clinical databases, track progress, resolve issues, and escalate when necessary. Quality & Compliance: Adhere to KPI and quality metrics, ensuring productivity and process improvement within ICSR management. Decision-Making: Execute decisions in line with operational policies, SOPs, and work instructions. Vendor/CRO Coordination: Ensure ICSR activities align with PV agreements and contracts. Training & Onboarding: Develop and update training materials, onboard new team members, provide feedback, and support the onboarding process.

Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in life sciences, clinical medicine, nursing, pharmacy, or equivalent experience; advanced degree preferred. Proficiency with Argus safety database and MS Office Suite. Minimum 2 years of experience in drug safety/pharmacovigilance or relevant clinical experience. Preferred 5-8 years of experience Strong understanding of global regulatory requirements (e.g., ICH, FDA, EMA, MHRA) for pharmacovigilance reporting. Excellent communication, problem-solving, time management, and attention to detail. Global cultural awareness and collaborative mindset.

title: Senior .net engineer (wfh)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior .net engineer (wfh) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior. Net Engineer

Resume: English Version only. Resume should have detailed discussion of project overview and job description. Highlight the following if applicable - Maui (Blazor, Razor, Xamarin); Healthcare projects; HIPAA knowledge; SAAS projects; US-based projects

Role: Full time contractor; Fully Remote

Work Hours: US time zone

Location: Brazil

Rate: R$20,000-22,000 per month

About the Company

We are a forward-thinking technology organization dedicated to developing innovative software solutions that improve outcomes for clients and end-users. Our engineering team designs, builds, and maintains scalable, high-quality applications that drive efficiency and innovation across industries. We are seeking an experienced Level III Software Engineer (contractor) to join our distributed team, contributing to complex projects with a focus on code quality, security, and collaboration.

Position Overview

As a Level III Software Engineer (contractor), you will apply your technical expertise to deliver high-quality code for moderately to highly complex projects. Working remotely with a U. S.-based team, you'll gain deep system knowledge and contribute to an Agile development workflow using Azure Dev Ops.

You will begin with automated testing and peer reviews, expanding into broader development tasks by months 2–3. The role will continue to evolve based on your strengths and project needs, while maintaining rigorous adherence to coding and security standards.

Key Responsibilities

Product Design & Development: Collaborate with stakeholders to design and implement software solutions aligned with technical and business objectives. Code Contributions: Write, optimize, and maintain efficient code, including enhancement of existing codebases, beginning around months 3–4.
