  • Articular o ecossistema interno (especialistas, delivery, parceiros) para montar respostas integradas dentro dos prazos comerciais.
  • Apoiar a evolução do portfólio de ofertas da vertical, trazendo leitura de mercado, tendências e cases que inspirem novas oportunidades.


Perfil que buscamos

  • Formação em Engenharia, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas, com pós-graduação ou MBA considerados um diferencial.
  • Experiência sólida em consultoria (Big 4, boutiques de estratégia ou integradores) atuando em projetos de transformação digital, supply chain, operações ou estratégia para clientes industriais.
  • Vivência em diagnóstico de processos, modelagem de soluções e gestão de iniciativas em ambientes complexos e multidisciplinares.
  • Vivência com Arquitetura de Dados, AI/GenAI, Machine Learning e componentes Cloud.
  • Familiaridade com temas de Indústria 4.0, convergência IT/OT, supply chain analytics, gestão de ativos, torre de controle ou aplicações de IA em operações.
  • Domínio de Power BI e Excel avançado; conhecimentos de Python, SQL ou plataformas de dados são bem-vindos.
  • Inglês avançado para interlocução com fornecedores, parceiros e times globais.
  • Postura consultiva, estruturação clara de raciocínio, velocidade na construção de materiais e energia para conduzir o ambiente e conectar pessoas.


Diferenciais

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil (Remote)


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview


As a Backend Team Lead , you will play a key role in leading the backend development team while contributing to the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions that support the company's mission and goals. You will guide and support the backend team while working closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities


  • Team Leadership:

Lead and support the backend engineering team, ensuring effective collaboration, task distribution, and delivery of high-quality software.

  • Platform Development:

Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel , ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.

  • Database Development:

Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes.

  • API Development and Integration:

Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.

  • Security Compliance:

Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA , by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols.


Additional Responsibilities


  • Mentor backend developers, providing guidance on best practices in backend development, code review, and team collaboration.
  • Support the team in resolving technical challenges and ensure consistent development standards across the team.
  • Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform.
  • Participate in an agile development environment, contributing to team coordination and iterative delivery processes, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software.


Competencies / Requirements


  • Technical Expertise:

Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL . Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git .

  • Experience:

At least 6+ years of experience in backend development , with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Previous experience leading or mentoring developers is required. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable.

  • Problem-Solving Skills:

Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions.

  • Communication Skills:

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

  • Attention to Detail:

A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform.


Benefits

  • Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

description:

A T-Systems , multinacional alemã pertencente ao Grupo Deutsche Telekom , busca profissional sênior de TI com sólida experiência híbrida em arquitetura de aplicações, desenvolvimento e gerenciamento de bancos de dados, com foco particular na integração de sistemas externos por meio de tecnologias middleware como MQ, Kafka, SFTP e CFT. Especializado em ambientes COBOL e DB2 (LUW/zOS), com vasta experiência na integração de sistemas legados e plataformas distribuídas modernas.



Perfil desejado


  • Experiência comprovada no projeto e implementação de soluções de integração ponta a ponta, conectando aplicações mainframe com ambientes de nuvem e Linux (Azure).
  • Sólida experiência em administração de DB2, otimização de desempenho, modelagem de dados e integração de dados, garantindo alta disponibilidade, escalabilidade e confiabilidade de sistemas de missão crítica.
  • Experiência prática com plataformas middleware (IBM MQ, Axway CFT), protocolos de transferência de arquivos (SFTP/FTPS) e streaming de eventos (Kafka), possibilitando a troca de dados robusta e eficiente em ambientes de sistemas heterogêneos.
  • Habilidade em analisar e resolver desafios complexos de múltiplas camadas, abrangendo aplicações, dados e infraestrutura. Experiência em automação, processamento em lote (Control-M/JCL) e modernização de ambientes legados.
  • Reconhecido por uma mentalidade holística, orientada à arquitetura, fortes habilidades de resolução de problemas e comunicação eficaz com stakeholders técnicos e de negócios em ambientes internacionais.



Requisitos Técnicos


  • COBOL – experiência prática em desenvolvimento e entendimento de sistemas legados.
  • DB2 LUW e/ou DB2 z/OS :
  • Administração e manutenção
  • Backups e recovery
  • Modelagem e DDL (ex: criação de tabelas)
  • Gerenciamento de índices
  • Performance tuning e análise
  • Carga e extração de dados (Load/Unload)
  • Conhecimentos em Mainframe e sua integração com sistemas distribuídos.
  • Cloud (Azure) e ambientes Linux , incluindo automação via scripting.
  • Control-M / JCL – criação e administração de workflows e agendamento de jobs.
  • IBM MQ – configuração de channels, queues e uso de ferramentas como MQ Explorer.
  • Rocket Enterprise Server .
  • Axway CFT – configuração de fluxos de transferência.
  • Protocolos de transferência: SFTP, FTPS .

  • Inglês avançado (mandatório)
  • Alemão (diferencial relevante)



Outros Requisitos

  • Disponibilidade para atuar no fuso horário da Alemanha .

About the Company

Sycomp’s diverse team of consultants and engineers deliver on the company’s mission to tackle challenging global IT projects through its state-of-the-art integration and warehouse centers and global technology partnerships. Headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, California, Sycomp has successfully shipped, deployed and managed complex IT projects and supporting assets in more than 150 countries helping its Fortune 500 customers and global partners realize a world without boundaries.



About the Role


The LATAM Decom Project Manager leads large-scale delivery programs executed through Managed Service Providers (MSPs) for hyperscaler environments. This role ensures end-to-end delivery of datacenter, network, and infrastructure projects across global regions with strict adherence to SLAs, security standards, compliance frameworks, and operational excellence. The PM serves as the primary interface between the hyperscaler, MSPs, vendors, and internal engineering teams.



Responsibilities



Program & Project Delivery

  • Lead planning, execution, and delivery of MSP-supported projects across compute, network, storage, and data-center operations.
  • Manage project lifecycle including scoping, resourcing, budgets, timelines, risks, and change control.
  • Maintain alignment with hyperscaler operational frameworks, including capacity build-outs, decom, retrofits, and infra expansions.
  • Coordinate regional and global deployments across multiple time zones with follow-the-sun governance.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for all ISPs delivering onsite or remote services.
  • Enforce SLA compliance & and quality KPIs.
  • Conduct regular governance calls, internal and external.
  • Drive corrective actions and continuous improvement with vendors.

  • Remove blockers, escalate critical issues, and maintain reliable delivery pipelines.
  • Ensure consistent communication between internal teams and external ISPs.
  • Coordinate with Global Logistics for shipping the orders to ensure SLAs are met.


Delivery Governance & Compliance

  • Ensure accurate documentation including MOPs (Methods of Procedure), SOPs, RACI, and risk registers.

Reporting & Metrics

  • Provide weekly and monthly executive reports on delivery status, risks, dependencies, and mitigations.
  • Track, productivity, throughput, and cycle-time metrics.



Qualifications


  • 8–12+ years of project/program management in large-scale datacenter or cloud infrastructure environments.
  • Experience working with or within hyperscalers.
  • Strong background managing MSP vendors delivering hardware, network, logistics, and field operations.
  • Deep understanding of data-center operational workflows, racks/cabling, networking basics, migrations, decom, and capacity builds.
  • Proficiency with PM tools.
  • Excellent communication, executive reporting, and stakeholder negotiation skills.
  • Experience with Lean, Agile, or scaled delivery frameworks.

  • PMP, PRINCE2, ITIL, or equivalent certifications.
  • Experience with global, multi-region deployments across AMER, EMEA, and APAC.
  • Ability to analyze operational metrics, and implement continuous improvement.

description:

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Solutions Architect | Data & AI (Presales)
description:

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


About the Opportunity:

As a Solutions Architect specialized in Data & AI, you will be responsible for driving business growth, expanding our market share, and accelerating our strategic partnership with Google Cloud.


This is a highly strategic, technical-commercial role. You will act as the trusted advisor for our clients, identifying new business opportunities, understanding complex business challenges, and architecting customized Google Cloud Data & AI solutions. Your ultimate goal is to bridge the gap between technical excellence and business value, presenting high-impact pitches to C-level executives to close deals and maximize Google Cloud adoption.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Business Development & Pipeline Growth: Identify, qualify, and develop new business opportunities for Data and Generative AI solutions within our Google Cloud ecosystem.
  • Google Partnership Alignment: Work closely with Google Cloud’s internal sales and technical teams (Partner Managers, Account Executives, and CE/CEs) to co-sell, align strategies, and map target accounts.
  • Executive Pitching & Value Selling: Lead discovery sessions and deliver compelling technical-commercial pitches to C-Level executives (CDO, CIO, CTO, CMO), translating complex technical architectures into clear business outcomes, ROI, and strategic value.
  • Solution Architecture & Prototyping: Design high-level, customized data architectures and coordinate rapid Proof of Concepts (PoCs) on Google Cloud to validate value and accelerate the client’s buying decision.
  • Proposal & RFP Leadership: Own the technical-commercial strategy for complex proposals and RFPs, defining the scope, commercial engineering, and value proposition of the proposed Google Cloud solution.
  • Advanced English


Required Qualifications:

  • Proven BDM or Technical Pre-Sales Experience: Solid track record in Business Development, Technical Sales, or Solution Architecture within the IT/Cloud Consulting industry, specifically driving cloud revenue.
  • Google Cloud Ecosystem Expertise: Deep knowledge of Google Cloud's data portfolio (BigQuery, Cloud Composer, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Dataflow).
  • AI & Generative AI Acumen: Solid understanding of Google Cloud’s AI capabilities (Vertex AI, Model Garden, Gemini API), and how to position them to solve real-world business problems.
  • C-Level Communication & Storytelling: Outstanding communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to build trust and influence decision-makers at the executive level.
  • Commercial Strategy: Ability to structure complex deals, build business cases focused on ROI, and understand consumption-based cloud business models.
  • Data Strategy Knowledge: Strong understanding of modern data paradigms, such as Data Lakes, Data Governance, Data Mesh, and how data readiness impacts AI success.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Google Cloud Certifications: Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer, Cloud Architect, or Digital Leader certifications are a strong differentiator.
  • Partner Ecosystem Experience: Prior experience working within the Google Cloud partner ecosystem or directly at Google.
  • Technical Background: Previous hands-on experience as a Data Engineer, Data Architect, or Data Scientist is a plus, ensuring high technical credibility with clients' engineering teams.


Work Environment:

  • A fast-paced, high-growth environment focused on innovation and results.
  • High visibility, working directly with strategic clients and global tech leaders (Google).
  • Direct impact on the company’s revenue growth and strategic partnership status.

title: Customer Support Representative, Level 1
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Support Representative, Level 1 em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


We are seeking an experienced Customer Support Representative to be on the front lines by answering questions and troubleshooting technical problems. You will assist customers with JoVE’s products and also guide clients through any technical issue they might encounter. If you are an energetic self-starter problem solver with a basic technical background and excellent communication skills, we want to talk to you. The Support Team here at JoVE is providing support not only to external customers but also to internal JoVE employees on a 24x7 basis.


Responsibilities:


  • Manage large amounts of incoming tickets.
  • Provide support to answer inquiries on products.
  • Accept and handle technical requests.
  • Triage tickets to the other teams.
  • Follow communication procedures, guidelines and policies.
  • Provide accurate, valid and complete information by using the right methods/tools.
  • Build sustainable relationships and trust with customers through open communication.
  • Handle customer complaints, provide appropriate solutions and alternatives within the time limits; follow up to ensure resolution.
  • Keep records of customer interactions, process customer accounts and file documents.
  • Take the extra mile to engage customers.
  • Performs other specific duties or assignments as directed by Team Manager.


Skills And Qualifications:


  • A Bachelor’s degree completed
  • 2+ years of demonstrable experience in customer support or customer success roles
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, verbal and written, are required to effectively and accurately communicate in English.
  • Ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical personnel in a clear and easy fashion.
  • Basic understanding of KPIs and Metrics.
  • Attention to detail is key to this position.
  • Must be able to accommodate flexible work schedules based on business needs.
  • Must have technical/diagnostic ability along with analytical ability to diagnose problems above basics, and basic mechanical skills.
  • Proficient with ticketing tools ( Zendesk, Jira, Salesforce).


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us
